66425.recognize_zh: 一顆巨大的成熟巨核細胞，細胞質豐富，細胞核分成許多粗大、互相分開又連在一起的分葉，像鹿角般分支（staghorn）；旁邊還有一大團血小板聚集。巨大高度分葉巨核細胞是原發性血小板增多症（ET）的典型所見。
features: Giant mature megakaryocyte, many times the diameter of nearby small mononuclear cells
Hyperlobulated nucleus with numerous bulbous lobes arranged in a branching staghorn configuration
Abundant, finely granular basophilic-to-lilac cytoplasm; low N:C ratio; no nucleoli
Large adjacent platelet clump (left) and scattered free platelets in the background
Background with scattered small lymphoid and erythroid cells and red cells with drying artifact
66425.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a giant megakaryocyte adjacent to a large clump of platelets, with scattered small mononuclear cells and red cells in the background. The megakaryocyte has abundant finely granular cytoplasm and a hyperlobulated nucleus composed of multiple bulbous lobes in a branching staghorn configuration, without nucleoli. Adjacent free platelets are abundant. A single cell cannot establish a myeloproliferative neoplasm, and marrow biopsy with megakaryocyte clustering, blood counts, and JAK2/CALR/MPL testing are required. Findings are suggestive of the giant hyperlobulated megakaryocytes seen in essential thrombocythemia.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes may increase in number but are normal-sized with ordinary lobation and do not form large, loose clusters of giant staghorn forms.
Megakaryocytes are atypical with hyperchromatic, cloud-like, poorly lobated nuclei and high N:C ratio, rather than mature hyperlobulated staghorn forms.
Megakaryocytes are pleomorphic in size with panmyelosis and elevated hemoglobin, rather than predominantly giant hyperlobulated forms.
Megakaryocytes are small, hypolobated dwarf forms with a myelocyte-predominant granulocytic hyperplasia, and BCR::ABL1 is present.

66361.recognize_zh: 中央一顆多核（約五至六個核）的大型細胞，核圓形大小相近、染色質細緻，細胞質濃密且邊緣有小泡狀突起；左側單核細胞呈兩色調細胞質（內淡外深）；右上為腎形核的巨噬細胞。多核與泡突細胞質是反應性間皮細胞的線索。
features: Large multinucleated cell with about five to six round-to-oval, similar-sized nuclei with fine chromatin
Dense basophilic cytoplasm with a fringe of surface blebs/microvilli
Single mesothelial cells (left) with round central nuclei and two-tone cytoplasm (pale inner zone, dense outer rim)
Macrophages with kidney-shaped nuclei and pale vacuolated cytoplasm in the upper right, a small lymphocyte, and crenated red cells
No marked nuclear pleomorphism, hyperchromasia, or prominent macronucleoli
66361.describe_en: Cytocentrifuged pericardial fluid shows a mixed population of cells on a background of crenated red cells. A large multinucleated mesothelial cell with five to six uniform round nuclei, fine chromatin, and dense cytoplasm bordered by surface blebs is present centrally, and single mesothelial cells with central round nuclei and two-tone cytoplasm are seen on the left. Macrophages with kidney-shaped nuclei and a small lymphocyte are also present. Although the title describes a cohesive cluster, the central structure here appears to be a single multinucleated cell rather than a group of separate cells. Nuclear features are uniform without significant atypia, and findings are consistent with reactive mesothelial cells.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells form three-dimensional clusters without windows and show pleomorphic nuclei with large nucleoli and cytoplasmic vacuoles, forming a second foreign population.
Morphologic overlap exists; marked atypia, large cell balls, BAP1 loss, or CDKN2A deletion favor mesothelioma over reactive change.
Histiocytic giant cells have pale, foamy or vacuolated cytoplasm with ill-defined borders and are CD68-positive, rather than dense cytoplasm with a bleb fringe and calretinin positivity.
Megakaryocytes have a single multilobated nucleus and granular pink cytoplasm rather than multiple separate round nuclei in dense blue cytoplasm.

66297.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中血小板數量明顯增多，三個箭頭分別指出正常大小血小板（左下）、大小接近紅血球的巨大血小板（giant platelet，中央）與大型血小板（右上），巨大血小板內可見紫紅色顆粒集中於中央。
features: Markedly increased platelets scattered throughout the field, with variation in platelet size (anisocytosis)
Central arrow: giant platelet approaching the diameter of an adjacent red cell, with central purple granulomere and pale hyalomere
Upper right arrow: large platelet about half a red cell diameter with normal granulation
Lower left arrow: normal-sized small platelet for comparison
Red cells normocytic without significant poikilocytosis; no leukocytes in this field
66297.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows increased platelets with marked variation in size. Normal-sized platelets are admixed with large platelets and occasional giant platelets approaching the size of a red cell, which retain normal granulation. The red cells are unremarkable and no platelet clumps are seen. In the setting of thrombocytosis, platelet anisocytosis with giant forms raises concern for a myeloproliferative neoplasm such as essential thrombocythemia, although reactive thrombocytosis can also show large platelets.

ddx.vs: Reactive thrombocytosis usually shows more uniform platelet size, whereas marked anisocytosis with giant forms favors a myeloproliferative neoplasm, requiring JAK2/CALR/MPL testing to separate them.
Inherited giant platelet disorders have low rather than high platelet counts, and MYH9 disorders show Döhle-like neutrophil inclusions.

ddx.dx: Small lymphocyte or red cell fragment
ddx.vs: A lymphocyte has a nucleus with a cytoplasmic rim and schistocytes lack granules, whereas giant platelets have a granular center without a nucleus.
Clumps are aggregates of several individual platelets with visible boundaries rather than a single enlarged platelet.

66233.recognize_zh: 視野中三顆彼此相鄰的中性球，細胞質佈滿大小不一的空泡（toxic vacuolation）並有細小深色顆粒，背景幾乎看不到血小板，另有一顆棘狀紅血球；描述中的梭形細菌在此解析度下僅隱約可見細小桿狀物，無法明確辨認，需高倍檢視或血液培養證實。
features: Three adjacent neutrophils with segmented nuclei and extensive cytoplasmic vacuolation (toxic vacuolation)
Cytoplasm shows fine dark granules/possible faint thin rod-like structures within vacuolated cytoplasm; individual bacteria not clearly resolved at this magnification
Few tiny linear extracellular objects in background (upper left), possibly bacteria versus debris
Marked paucity of platelets across the field, consistent with thrombocytopenia
Normocytic red cells with an occasional echinocyte; no schistocytes clearly identified in this field
66233.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows three neutrophils with segmented nuclei and prominent toxic vacuolation of the cytoplasm. Platelets are markedly reduced, and red cells are largely normocytic with an occasional echinocyte. Faint thin intracytoplasmic and a few extracellular linear structures may represent bacteria, but they are not definitively resolved at this magnification, so review at oil immersion (and Gram stain) is recommended. In a febrile patient with DIC, toxic vacuolation with suspected fusiform organisms is suggestive of overwhelming bacteremia, here confirmed as Capnocytophaga canimorsus on blood culture.

ddx.dx: Toxic changes of sepsis without visible bacteremia
ddx.vs: Vacuolation alone is nonspecific; definite intracellular organisms with uniform fusiform shape and consistent staining are required to report bacteria on the smear.
Storage vacuoles appear in delayed samples as small uniform vacuoles without toxic granulation or organisms; a fresh smear resolves this.

ddx.dx: Jordans anomaly / neutral lipid storage disease
ddx.vs: These show lipid vacuoles in all neutrophils (and monocytes) persistently in healthy individuals, without infection or bacteria.

ddx.dx: Stain precipitate or platelet fragments mimicking bacteria
ddx.vs: Precipitate is irregular, refractile and lies above cells and on red cells, whereas bacteria are uniform rods within neutrophil cytoplasm.

65977.recognize_zh: 高度細胞密集的骨髓抹片中，一顆小型細胞具單一圓核與灰藍色細顆粒狀細胞質，大小僅約前骨髓細胞，旁邊為核分葉少的小型巨核細胞，屬 CML 常見的小巨核細胞（micromegakaryocyte / dwarf megakaryocyte）。
features: Small megakaryocytic cell roughly the size of a promyelocyte with a single round nucleus
Moderate grayish-blue cytoplasm with fine granularity and slightly fluffy margin
Adjacent larger megakaryocyte with abundant granular cytoplasm and only two nuclear lobes (hypolobated)
Markedly hypercellular smear crowded with granulocytic precursors at various stages of maturation
Thick, overlapping preparation with intense staining limits fine chromatin assessment
65977.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is markedly hypercellular, with crowded granulocytic precursors across the maturation spectrum. Centrally there is a small megakaryocyte approximately the size of a promyelocyte, with a single round nucleus and pale gray-blue finely granular cytoplasm, adjacent to a larger megakaryocyte with a hypolobated, bilobed nucleus. The thickness of the smear limits evaluation of nuclear detail. In the context of BCR::ABL1-positive disease, the small hypolobated (dwarf) megakaryocytes and granulocytic hyperplasia are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: Granulocytic precursors have azurophilic granules with a perinuclear Golgi zone and lack the gray-blue, platelet-type granular cytoplasm with budding margins.
Plasma cells have deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof and clock-face chromatin.
Morphology overlaps; separation relies on context: MDS shows dysplasia with cytopenias and no BCR::ABL1, whereas CML shows granulocytic hyperplasia with basophilia and BCR::ABL1.
Megakaryoblasts have fine blast chromatin, nucleoli and agranular basophilic cytoplasm with blebs, confirmed by CD41/CD61 flow.

65849.recognize_zh: 低倍下整塊組織由放射狀排列、密集的纖細菌絲構成（A，H&E）；B 的 Grocott 銀染將菌絲染成黑色，放大後可見大量平行、分枝的管狀菌絲切面，符合氣管內麴菌（Aspergillus）團塊。
features: Panel A (H&E): round, densely packed mass composed of radially arranged, thin fungal hyphae with a more compact eosinophilic/basophilic rim
Panel B (Grocott, low power): hyphae stain black and are densest at the periphery, highlighting the radiating architecture
High-power Grocott inset: numerous black tubular hyphae of uniform narrow width with branching and many cross-sectioned profiles
Septation and acute-angle branching are suggested but not clearly resolvable at this image resolution
No appreciable host tissue within the mass, consistent with a mass-forming fungal aggregate
65849.describe_en: Sections of the endobronchial lesion show a well-circumscribed, densely packed mass composed almost entirely of radially arranged fungal hyphae (H&E). Grocott methenamine silver stain highlights the hyphae in black, which at higher magnification appear as numerous narrow, uniform-width branching tubular structures with many cross-sectioned profiles. The fine morphologic detail of septation and branching angle is limited at this resolution. Findings are consistent with a mass-forming septate mould infection, compatible with Aspergillus, in a post-allogeneic transplant patient; culture or molecular identification is recommended for species confirmation.

ddx.vs: Mucorales hyphae are broad, ribbon-like and pauciseptate with right-angle branching and often stain weakly with GMS.
These hyaline moulds are histologically very similar to Aspergillus, so fungal culture or PCR is needed to separate them.
Candida forms a mixture of budding yeasts and pseudohyphae with constrictions rather than uniform true septate hyphae.
Actinomyces granules are made of very thin filamentous bacteria (<1 micron) that are Gram positive, not broader fungal hyphae.

65785.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散佈圖：紅色標記的「suspected atypical cells」在 CD45 呈亮陽性，側向散射（SSC）偏低到中等，且 CD19、CD20、CD10、CD73、CD86、CD123 皆為陰性，代表一群非 B 細胞、非顆粒球的淋巴樣族群，需再以 T/NK 標記確認。
features: CD45 vs SSC plot: red atypical population is CD45 bright with low to intermediate SSC, extending toward the granulocyte SSC range
CD19 negative and CD20 negative, clearly separated from the small orange normal B-cell population
CD10 negative, separated from the CD10-positive green granulocytes
CD73, CD86 and CD123 negative; CD38 negative to dim
No T-cell or NK-cell markers (CD3, CD2, CD7, CD56, TCR gamma-delta) are displayed in this figure
65785.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plots show a distinct population (painted red, gated as suspected atypical cells) that is CD45 bright with low to intermediate side scatter. This population lacks CD19, CD20, CD10, CD73, CD86 and CD123 and is CD38 negative to dim, distinguishing it from residual normal B cells (orange), granulocytes (green) and CD123-positive cells (cyan). The markers shown exclude a B-cell or myeloid blast phenotype, but T/NK lineage markers are not included in this figure. Findings are compatible with an abnormal non-B lymphoid population, and in the appropriate clinical context support hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma pending CD3, TCR gamma-delta, CD5 and CD56 evaluation.

ddx.vs: T-LGL is typically TCR alpha-beta, CD8+, CD57+ and CD5 dim, whereas HSTCL is usually TCR gamma-delta, CD5-, CD8-, CD57- with sinusoidal marrow infiltration.
NK cells lack surface CD3 and TCR and are EBV positive, which requires markers not shown here.
Myeloblasts are CD45 dim with CD34, CD117 or CD13/CD33 expression, not CD45 bright.
Hairy cells also have increased SSC but are CD19/CD20 bright with CD11c, CD25 and CD103, unlike this CD19/CD20-negative population.

65017.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中一顆淋巴樣細胞，核比周圍紅血球略大、邊緣有多處凹陷折疊，形成腦迴狀（cerebriform）的輪廓，染色質濃密、細胞質極少；此為 Sézary 細胞的典型外觀，但影像放大後較模糊。
features: Lymphoid cell slightly larger than adjacent red cells
Very high N:C ratio with a thin rim of pale cytoplasm
Nucleus with multiple deep indentations and folds giving a cerebriform contour
Dense, hyperchromatic chromatin; nucleoli not evident
Image resolution is limited by digital enlargement
65017.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an atypical lymphoid cell, slightly larger than adjacent red cells, with a very high nuclear to cytoplasmic ratio and a hyperchromatic nucleus bearing multiple deep indentations that produce a convoluted, cerebriform outline. Nucleoli are not evident and the cytoplasm forms a thin pale rim. Resolution is limited by enlargement of the image. In a patient with mycosis fungoides, the findings are consistent with a circulating Sézary cell; quantification by flow cytometry (CD4:CD8 ratio, loss of CD7 and/or CD26) and T-cell clonality studies are needed to stage blood involvement.

ddx.vs: ATLL cells have polylobated flower-like nuclei with deep clefts separating distinct petals and are associated with HTLV-1 serology.
Reactive lymphocytes have more abundant cytoplasm and only occasional shallow clefts, without a population of cerebriform cells.
T-PLL cells have a visible nucleolus and basophilic cytoplasmic blebs, and are usually TCL1-positive.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma or follicular lymphoma cells
ddx.vs: These B-cell lymphoma cells can show nuclear clefts but are CD19/CD20-positive rather than CD4-positive T cells on flow cytometry.

65465.recognize_zh: 這是九格流式細胞儀圖：紅色的芽細胞群位於 CD45 弱陽性、低側散射（SSC）的位置，並呈 HLA-DR 與 CD123 強陽性（標為 BPDC）、CD4 陽性、CD56 部分陽性、CD304 陽性；CD34、CD117、MPO、cCD3、CD19、CD14、CD64 則全為陰性。這個「CD4+/CD56+/CD123 強陽性、其他系別標記陰性」的組合，是 BPDCN 的免疫表型。
features: CD45 versus SSC: red blast gate with dim CD45 and low side scatter, distinct from granulocytes, monocytes and lymphocytes
HLA-DR versus CD123: blasts are bright CD123 and HLA-DR positive, separate from the basophil gate (CD123+/HLA-DR−)
CD4 positive with surface CD3 negative; CD56 variable positive with CD8 negative
CD304 (BDCA-4) positive and CD38 positive, CD34 and CD117 negative
Lineage markers negative: cMPO, cCD3, CD19, CD14 and CD64
65465.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plots show a distinct blast population (red) with dim to moderate CD45 and low side scatter. The blasts are HLA-DR+, bright CD123+, CD304+, CD4+, CD38+ and variably CD56+, and are negative for CD34, CD117, surface and cytoplasmic CD3, CD8, CD19, cytoplasmic MPO, CD14 and CD64. The lack of myeloid, monocytic, B- and T-lineage markers together with co-expression of CD4, CD56 and bright CD123 is characteristic. Findings support a diagnosis of blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm; TCF4, TCL1 or CD2AP on tissue can further confirm.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Monocytic AML is often CD4+/CD56+/CD123+ but expresses CD14, CD64, CD11b or lysozyme, which are negative here.

ddx.dx: Mature plasmacytoid dendritic cell proliferation associated with myeloid neoplasm
ddx.vs: Reactive or MN-associated pDCs are CD56 negative, often CD34-positive myeloid blasts coexist, and the pDCs show a mature CD123+/CD303+ phenotype without an atypical dominant blast population.
NK/T neoplasms express CD2, CD7 or cytoplasmic CD3 and lack bright CD123 with HLA-DR.

ddx.dx: Early T-precursor or mixed-phenotype acute leukemia
ddx.vs: These express cCD3 and/or MPO and stem-cell markers such as CD34/CD117, all negative in this case.

65401.recognize_zh: 雖標題寫切片，影像其實是骨髓抹片拼圖：可見多顆大型、染色質較開放的漿細胞，核偏位、細胞質藍而豐富帶核周淡染區，另有雙核形態，支持漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Increased plasma cells, many large with abundant blue cytoplasm and eccentric nuclei
Perinuclear hof and open to moderately coarse chromatin; occasional nucleoli
Binucleated plasma cells and cells with irregular cytoplasmic outlines
Admixed erythroid precursors, neutrophils and lymphocytes
One panel shows an elongated cell with a long cytoplasmic tail (smearing artifact)
65401.describe_en: Composite images show Romanowsky-stained bone marrow aspirate smears rather than histologic biopsy sections. Numerous plasma cells are present, many enlarged with abundant basophilic cytoplasm, eccentric nuclei, perinuclear hof and relatively open chromatin, including binucleated forms. Residual erythroid precursors, granulocytes and lymphocytes are admixed. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma; the specimen type differs from the 'biopsy' description, and CD138 with kappa/lambda studies on the core are recommended for quantification and clonality.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are small, mature, polytypic and lack enlarged or binucleated forms.
Cells are uniformly blastic with prominent central nucleoli, high Ki-67 and frequent EBV positivity rather than a spectrum of recognizable plasma cells.
Osteoblasts are larger, occur in clusters in young patients, and their pale Golgi zone is separated from the nucleus.

65209.recognize_zh: 周邊血液與骨髓中的非典型淋巴球，細胞質淡藍、核染色質成熟，細胞質內可見多顆較大的粉紅至嗜酸性圓形包涵體（pseudo-Chédiak-Higashi inclusions），在觸片、凝塊切片仍可見並呈不一 PAS 陽性，出現在低惡度 B 細胞腫瘤（邊緣區淋巴瘤）。
features: Medium-sized atypical lymphocytes with round to indented nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin and moderate pale blue cytoplasm
Several discrete, rounded pink-to-eosinophilic cytoplasmic inclusions of variable size, larger than normal azurophilic granules
Similar inclusion-bearing lymphoid cells in marrow aspirate and a touch preparation cluster, with scattered small cytoplasmic vacuoles
Clot section (H&E): monotonous small lymphoid infiltrate with pink cytoplasmic granular inclusions
PAS: variable granular magenta cytoplasmic positivity in lymphoid cells
65209.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows atypical mature-appearing lymphocytes with moderately condensed chromatin and pale blue cytoplasm containing several large, round, pink to eosinophilic inclusions. Identical inclusion-bearing lymphoid cells are present in the bone marrow aspirate and touch preparations, and the clot section shows a diffuse small lymphoid infiltrate with cytoplasmic eosinophilic inclusions that are variably PAS positive. There are no features of blasts in these fields. In conjunction with a CD5-/CD10- monotypic B-cell population, findings are consistent with a low-grade B-cell lymphoma (favor marginal zone lymphoma) with pseudo-Chédiak-Higashi inclusions.

ddx.vs: True CHS shows giant granules in all granulocytes and many lymphocytes from infancy with albinism and immunodeficiency, not a neoplastic B-cell population in an adult.
LGL cells have abundant cytoplasm with fine to coarse azurophilic granules and are CD3+/CD8+/CD57+ T cells or NK cells, whereas these are monotypic B cells.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell neoplasm with Russell or Dutcher bodies
ddx.vs: Russell bodies are globular immunoglobulin inclusions in plasma cells and Dutcher bodies are intranuclear, whereas these are cytoplasmic inclusions in lymphocytes lacking plasma cell cytology.

ddx.dx: AML or ALL with pseudo-Chédiak-Higashi granules
ddx.vs: In acute leukemias the inclusions are in blasts with fine chromatin and nucleoli, whereas these cells have mature chromatin and a mature B-cell phenotype.

65081.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結遍布大小不一的濾泡：有的生發中心偏小、萎縮並被寬厚套區環繞，有的一個套區內含多個生發中心，也有較大的增生型生發中心，濾泡間血管增多，這種新舊混雜的濾泡樣貌符合 Castleman 病。
features: Preserved nodal architecture with numerous follicles scattered through cortex and paracortex at low power
Polymorphic germinal centers: small regressed centers with broad mantle zones alongside larger hyperplastic pale centers
Occasional follicles containing multiple germinal centers within one mantle zone (upper field)
Prominent interfollicular vessels, some with thickened hyalinized walls and congestion
Interfollicular areas expanded without sheets of atypical cells (cytology not assessable at this power)
65081.describe_en: Low-power view of the lymph node shows preserved architecture with numerous follicles containing germinal centers of varying size and appearance, ranging from small regressed forms surrounded by expanded mantle zones to larger hyperplastic germinal centers, with occasional follicles containing more than one germinal center. The interfollicular regions show increased vascularity with prominent, focally hyalinized vessels. Cytologic detail and plasma cell content cannot be assessed at this magnification. The findings are compatible with Castleman disease-type morphology and, with supportive clinical and laboratory criteria and negative HHV-8, idiopathic multicentric Castleman disease.

ddx.dx: Reactive follicular hyperplasia (autoimmune disease, e.g. rheumatoid arthritis or SLE)
ddx.vs: Autoimmune lymphadenopathy can mimic iMCD; it has uniformly hyperplastic polarized germinal centers without regressed forms, and clinical serology is needed to exclude it.
HHV-8 MCD shows LANA-1-positive plasmablasts in mantle zones and usually occurs in HIV-positive patients.
FL shows back-to-back monotonous follicles with absent mantles and BCL-2-positive germinal centers rather than a mix of regressed and hyperplastic follicles.
AITL has regressed follicles and vascular proliferation but an expanded paracortex of atypical clear TFH cells with extrafollicular CD21+ meshworks and clonal TCR.

64953.recognize_zh: 拼圖中可見多個偏心核、深藍色細胞質且有核旁淡染區（hof）的大型漿細胞，部分為雙核或多核，並聚集成小團；背景有大量顆粒球系前驅細胞，看起來比較像骨髓抽吸抹片，本圖中未見明確的紅血球錢串（rouleaux）。
features: Atypical plasma cells, many large, with eccentric round nuclei and deep basophilic cytoplasm
Perinuclear hof and irregular cytoplasmic blebs/projections in several cells
Binucleate and multinucleate plasma cells, some forming small clusters
Some plasma cells with finer chromatin and visible nucleoli (immature forms)
Background with numerous granulocytic precursors and neutrophils, suggesting marrow rather than peripheral blood
Red cells overlap in thicker areas but convincing rouleaux stacks are not evident
64953.describe_en: Composite of Wright-stained fields shows numerous plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, deeply basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear clearing, including large, binucleate and multinucleate forms, some with finer chromatin and nucleoli, and occasional small clusters. The background contains abundant granulocytic precursors at various stages of maturation, which is more in keeping with a bone marrow aspirate than the peripheral blood smear stated in the title. Definite rouleaux formation is not clearly demonstrated in these fields, as red cells are mainly overlapping in thick areas. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma; if this is peripheral blood, the circulating plasma cell burden would raise concern for plasma cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are small, mature, uninucleate and polytypic, whereas these include large, multinucleate and nucleolated forms.

Plasmablastic lymphoma shows sheets of immunoblastic cells with large central nucleoli, often EBV (EBER)-positive and extramedullary, rather than recognizable mature-to-immature plasma cells with hofs.
LPL comprises a spectrum of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with mature plasma cells, lacking the large atypical multinucleate plasma cells seen here.

64505.recognize_zh: 六格圖中每個細胞都比周圍紅血球大很多，核圓而偏心、染色質稍粗，細胞質豐富並滿布粗大的紫紅色嗜天青顆粒（primary granules），部分顆粒覆蓋核上，是早幼粒細胞（promyelocyte）的典型樣貌。
features: Large round cells (roughly 2-2.5 times a red cell diameter) with abundant cytoplasm
Round to oval, often eccentric nucleus with slightly coarse chromatin; nucleoli not conspicuous
Numerous coarse purple-red azurophilic (primary) granules scattered throughout the cytoplasm and overlying the nucleus
Lightly basophilic cytoplasm; perinuclear clearing (Golgi zone) not prominent
No Auer rods or bundles; background red cells and platelets on a peripheral blood smear
64505.describe_en: The composite shows six individual cells from a peripheral blood smear, each considerably larger than the surrounding red cells. The cells have a round to oval, often eccentric nucleus with slightly condensed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, surrounded by abundant cytoplasm containing numerous coarse azurophilic granules that also overlie the nucleus. No Auer rods, faggot cells, or bilobed nuclei are identified. The cells are consistent with promyelocytes; their presence in blood indicates a left-shifted or leukoerythroblastic picture and, if numerous or atypical, should prompt exclusion of acute promyelocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have finer chromatin, visible nucleoli, a higher N:C ratio, and absent or only few fine granules, whereas promyelocytes are packed with coarse azurophilic granules.
Myelocytes show a more condensed nucleus, a pale Golgi hof and predominance of fine lilac secondary granules rather than coarse purple primary granules.
APL promyelocytes have bilobed or reniform nuclei, very dense granules or hypogranular cytoplasm, and Auer rods/faggot bundles, and PML::RARA confirms the diagnosis.
Toxic neutrophils have a segmented or band nucleus with dark granules, whereas promyelocytes have a round unsegmented nucleus.

64569.recognize_zh: 大量紅血球帶有粗大嗜鹼性點彩、Pappenheimer 小體與 Howell-Jolly 小體，血小板也偏多；放大小圖可見紅血球內不規則環狀、帶紫色小點的包涵體，容易誤認為瘧原蟲或 Babesia，其實是脾切除後不穩定血紅素 Hb Southampton 的包涵體。
features: Many red cells with coarse basophilic stippling and clustered Pappenheimer bodies
Howell-Jolly bodies and polychromatic red cells, consistent with post-splenectomy hemolysis
Inset: pleomorphic ring-like or irregular pale inclusions with dark purple dots mimicking intraerythrocytic parasites
No schizonts, gametocytes, tetrad forms, or extracellular merozoites
Increased platelets; scattered lymphocytes and a segmented neutrophil
Anisocytosis with macrocytic red cells and occasional target cells
64569.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows anisocytosis with increased polychromasia, prominent coarse basophilic stippling, Pappenheimer bodies, and Howell-Jolly bodies, along with an increased platelet count. At higher magnification (inset), a subset of red cells contains pleomorphic ring-like inclusions with purple dots that superficially resemble Plasmodium or Babesia trophozoites. No schizonts, gametocytes, or Maltese-cross tetrads are identified. In the setting of known hemoglobin Southampton and prior splenectomy, the findings are consistent with unstable hemoglobin inclusions and asplenic changes rather than parasitemia.

ddx.vs: True ring forms have a crisp chromatin dot with a thin regular cytoplasmic ring and may show gametocytes, and parasite antigen or PCR testing is positive.
Babesia shows small pleomorphic rings, sometimes extracellular forms and pathognomonic tetrads, with positive PCR, unlike these irregular inclusions with stippling.

ddx.dx: Lead poisoning or thalassemia with basophilic stippling
ddx.vs: These show stippling without Heinz-body-like ring inclusions; an unstable hemoglobin is confirmed by isopropanol stability test and HBB sequencing.
Pappenheimer bodies alone are iron-positive on Prussian blue, whereas unstable hemoglobin precipitates stain with supravital dyes (Heinz bodies).

64441.recognize_zh: 腎臟切片的腎小管之間有小淋巴細胞浸潤。腎臟檢體的流式細胞儀顯示 κ 限制的 B 細胞 CD10 陽性，連背景的 λ 多株 B 細胞也有 CD10 訊號（藍色箭頭）；但同時期淋巴結的流式為 CD10 陰性，CD10 免疫染色也只染腎小管、不染淋巴瘤細胞，這是腎小管脫落 CD10 造成的偽陽性。
features: Panel A (H&E): renal cortex with dense interstitial infiltrate of small lymphoid cells separating tubules
Panel B (renal biopsy flow): CD19+/CD20+ B cells in the CD10-positive quadrant (79.5%), predominantly kappa-restricted (91.1%)
Background polytypic lambda B cells (blue, arrow) also appear CD10-positive, indicating nonspecific staining
Panel C (subcarinal lymph node flow): same kappa-restricted B cells but CD10-negative (98.5%)
Panel D (CD10 IHC): strong staining of renal tubular epithelium with negative interstitial lymphoma cells
64441.describe_en: Renal biopsy shows a dense interstitial infiltrate of small lymphoid cells between tubules. Flow cytometry of the renal biopsy shows a kappa-restricted CD19+/CD20+ B-cell population that appears CD10-positive, with CD10 signal also on background polytypic lambda B cells, whereas flow cytometry of the concurrent subcarinal lymph node shows the same kappa-restricted population lacking CD10. CD10 immunohistochemistry stains renal tubules strongly but not the lymphoma cells. Findings are consistent with recurrent extranodal marginal zone (MALT) lymphoma with false-positive CD10 by flow cytometry, attributable to CD10 (neprilysin) shed from renal tubules.

ddx.vs: True follicular lymphoma shows CD10 and BCL6 by IHC on tumor cells, follicular architecture and IGH::BCL2 fusion, all absent here.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, germinal center type
ddx.vs: DLBCL consists of large cells with CD10 or BCL6 positive by IHC, not small cells with CD10 only on flow cytometry.
Burkitt lymphoma shows medium-sized cells with a starry-sky pattern, Ki-67 near 100% and MYC rearrangement with true CD10 expression.
Mantle cell lymphoma is CD5+ and cyclin D1/SOX11-positive, whereas this infiltrate is CD5-negative.

64377.recognize_zh: 新生兒周邊血中出現數顆胚芽球，細胞質深藍、邊緣有細胞質泡狀突起（cytoplasmic bleb），符合巨核母細胞（megakaryoblast）型態；背景可見形狀不規則的血小板，配合 Down 症候群即指向 TAM。
features: Several blasts, variable in size (small to large), with high N:C ratio
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with finely granular chromatin
Deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm with cytoplasmic blebs/tag-like projections (megakaryoblast-like)
One smaller blast with a cytoplasmic vacuole
Background with an irregular, granular platelet and a large pale-staining platelet-like fragment
Red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis with occasional echinocytes/crenated forms
64377.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear from a neonate shows circulating blasts of variable size with high N:C ratios, finely dispersed chromatin and scant deeply basophilic cytoplasm; one blast shows a prominent cytoplasmic bleb, a feature suggestive of megakaryoblastic differentiation. Platelets include irregular granular forms and a large pale-staining platelet-like fragment. Red cells show mild poikilocytosis. In a neonate with trisomy 21 and a GATA1 mutation, findings are consistent with transient abnormal myelopoiesis.

ddx.dx: Myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome (ML-DS)
ddx.vs: ML-DS usually presents after the neonatal period (typically before age 4-5) with persistent disease and additional mutations, whereas TAM appears in the first days of life and usually resolves spontaneously; morphology alone cannot separate them.

ddx.dx: Acute megakaryoblastic leukemia in a non-Down syndrome infant
ddx.vs: Morphology is similar, but absence of trisomy 21/GATA1 mutation and frequent fusion genes such as CBFA2T3::GLIS2 or RBM15::MRTFA distinguish it.
Reactive states show a left-shifted granulocytic series with toxic changes rather than blasts with cytoplasmic blebs.

ddx.dx: Circulating normal neonatal blasts or NRBC
ddx.vs: Occasional blasts may be seen in stressed neonates, and nucleated red cells have condensed chromatin and polychromatic cytoplasm without blebs.

64185.recognize_zh: 四格圖中的嗜中性球（多為帶狀核或分葉較少）細胞質邊緣可見淡藍灰色、邊界模糊的小塊狀包涵體（Döhle bodies），搭配左移，符合敗血症等感染時的毒性變化。
features: Four panels of neutrophils, most with band or hyposegmented nuclei (left shift)
Small, pale blue-gray, poorly demarcated cytoplasmic inclusions located near the cell periphery (Dohle bodies)
Cytoplasm with fine to slightly increased granulation; no giant granules
Nuclei with coarse clumped chromatin; no hypersegmentation
Background normocytic red cells with some elongated and tear-drop shaped cells in the lower right panel; platelets not prominent
64185.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear composite shows four neutrophils, predominantly band and hyposegmented forms, each containing small, pale blue-gray, ill-defined cytoplasmic inclusions typically located at the cell periphery. There are no giant azurophilic granules, and the platelets present are not enlarged. Background red cells are largely normocytic, with some elongated forms in one panel. Findings are consistent with Dohle bodies with left-shifted neutrophils, a reactive toxic change compatible with the clinical history of sepsis.

ddx.vs: MYH9 inclusions are larger, more sharply defined, spindle-shaped, and accompanied by giant platelets and thrombocytopenia, and are present in all granulocytes.
CHS inclusions are giant, dense azurophilic or grayish-green granules representing fused lysosomes, rather than faint pale-blue ER remnants.
Microorganisms are discrete, uniform, darkly staining rods, cocci, or yeast forms often within vacuoles rather than pale amorphous patches.
Anaplasma morulae are dense, stippled, dark purple-blue clusters within the cytoplasm rather than pale homogeneous blue patches.

63993.recognize_zh: Perls 鐵染色高倍下，一個大細胞的胞質整片被染成深藍色、僅隱約見到偏心的細胞核，周圍粉紅色有核細胞不含鐵，代表這個類 Gaucher 細胞攝取大量鐵。
features: Single large cell with intense diffuse blue Prussian blue-positive cytoplasm
Eccentric, partially obscured round nucleus within the iron-laden cell
Surrounding nucleated marrow cells negative for iron with pink nuclear counterstain
Image is partly out of focus, limiting assessment of granule pattern and cytoplasmic texture
63993.describe_en: Perls' Prussian blue stain of the bone marrow aspirate at higher power shows a single large cell with intense, diffuse blue cytoplasmic staining and an eccentric, partially obscured nucleus. The surrounding nucleated cells, which have pink counterstained nuclei, are iron negative, and no ring sideroblasts can be evaluated in this field. The image is somewhat out of focus, limiting assessment of granule pattern. In the context of AML with Gaucher-like cells, findings are consistent with an iron-laden pseudo-Gaucher macrophage.

ddx.vs: Ordinary storage macrophages contain coarse clumped iron granules without Gaucher-like fibrillar cytoplasm on the Giemsa-stained smear, so correlation with the Romanowsky stain is required.
Precipitate lies on top of the smear without cell boundaries, whereas here the staining is confined to the cytoplasm around a nucleus.
Ring sideroblasts are smaller erythroid precursors with discrete perinuclear granules forming a ring, not a large cell with diffuse cytoplasmic staining.

63929.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指為一顆大型漿細胞，核偏心圓形、染色質粗塊狀，核周有淡染區（hof），細胞質深藍、外圍一圈鮮豔的洋紅至紫紅色纖維狀邊緣並向外碎裂，這種紅色鑲邊就是火焰細胞（flame cell），代表細胞質內大量免疫球蛋白。
features: Large plasma cell (arrow) with an eccentric round nucleus and coarsely clumped chromatin
Pale perinuclear Golgi zone (hof) within deeply basophilic inner cytoplasm
Peripheral cytoplasm with an intense magenta-fuchsia fringed, fibrillar rim (flame cell appearance)
Fragmented magenta cytoplasmic material shed into the adjacent background
Adjacent segmented neutrophil and small lymphocyte for size comparison; background red cells and platelets
63929.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows red cells, a segmented neutrophil and a small lymphocyte adjacent to a large plasma cell (arrow). The plasma cell has an eccentric round nucleus with clumped chromatin, a perinuclear hof and abundant cytoplasm that is basophilic centrally but shows a vivid magenta, fringed and fibrillar peripheral rim, with fragments of similar material in the nearby background. This is a flame cell, reflecting immunoglobulin accumulation (often IgA). Flame cells are not specific for malignancy, but in the setting of multiple myeloma the finding is consistent with plasma cell neoplasm, to be quantified with plasma cell percentage and clonality studies.

ddx.vs: Flame cells can occur in reactive conditions, so polytypic kappa/lambda expression and a low plasma cell percentage separate reactive from clonal plasma cells.

ddx.dx: Mott cell or Russell body plasma cell
ddx.vs: Mott cells contain multiple round pale Russell bodies (grape-like globules), not a diffuse magenta cytoplasmic fringe.

ddx.dx: Thesaurocyte (IgA myeloma) or Gaucher-like pseudo-Gaucher cell
ddx.vs: Thesaurocytes are large plasma cells with pale, voluminous cytoplasm, and pseudo-Gaucher cells show wrinkled fibrillar cytoplasm with small central nuclei rather than a flame-colored rim.
Eosinophils have bilobed nuclei with discrete orange granules and mast cells have dense purple granules, not a hof-bearing plasma cell with an eccentric clock-face nucleus.

63801.recognize_zh: 大型非典型細胞呈強棕色的細胞膜與細胞質（含高基氏體區）CD15 染色，部分為雙核細胞，背景小淋巴球陰性；大細胞成群聚集，符合具霍奇金淋巴瘤特徵的灰區淋巴瘤中 CD15 表現。
features: Large atypical cells with strong membranous and cytoplasmic CD15 staining, including paranuclear (Golgi) accentuation
Occasional binucleated or bilobed large cells with vesicular nuclei
Positive cells arranged in clusters and cohesive aggregates rather than only scattered singly
Small background lymphocytes and stromal cells negative (blue hematoxylin counterstain)
Granular extracellular/background brown staining, possibly from granulocyte debris
63801.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD15 shows numerous large atypical cells with strong membranous and cytoplasmic staining with paranuclear dot-like accentuation, some of which are binucleated. The positive cells form clusters and confluent aggregates, while the small background lymphocytes are negative. Interpretation requires correlation with CD30, CD20, PAX5, CD79a and OCT2/BOB1 expression. In the context of variable CD20 and CD79a expression in the same large cells, the findings support mediastinal gray zone lymphoma (B-cell lymphoma with features intermediate between DLBCL and classic Hodgkin lymphoma).

ddx.vs: Reed-Sternberg cells are CD15/CD30 positive but usually scattered in a rich inflammatory background with weak PAX5 and loss of CD20, CD79a and B-cell transcription factors.
Sheets of large cells with strong uniform CD20/CD79a, often weak CD30, and typically CD15 negative.
CD30-positive hallmark cells that are CD15 usually negative, PAX5 negative, and express T-cell markers or ALK.
Myeloid cells are smaller with segmented or band nuclei, CD15 positive but CD30 negative.

63737.recognize_zh: 這是一支紫頭 EDTA 採血管的照片，傾斜後管壁上沾滿一粒一粒的紅色顆粒狀凝集物，而不是均勻的全血，代表室溫下紅血球已經凝集（體外冷凝集），加溫到 37°C 通常會散開。
features: Photograph of a lavender-top (EDTA) blood collection tube held horizontally
Coarse granular red clumps coating the inner tube wall instead of a smooth uniform film
Visible macroscopic agglutinates at room temperature
No fibrin clot or gross hemolysis evident
63737.describe_en: Gross photograph of an EDTA-anticoagulated whole blood tube shows coarse, granular red cell aggregates coating the inner tube wall when the tube is tilted, rather than a smooth homogeneous film. This macroscopic agglutination at room temperature indicates in vitro cryoagglutination due to a cold agglutinin. Warming the tube to 37°C should disperse the agglutinates, and a repeat CBC on a pre-warmed sample corrects spurious results such as low RBC count, falsely high MCV and MCHC. A true clot would appear as a single cohesive fibrin mass rather than dispersed granules.

ddx.vs: A clotted sample shows a cohesive fibrin clot or strands that do not disperse with warming.
Cryoproteins cause a gel or precipitate in plasma after cooling rather than granular red-cell clumps, and cryofibrinogen is seen in plasma but not serum.
Rouleaux cause rapid sedimentation but not grossly visible granular clumps on the tube wall.

63673.recognize_zh: 血片中淋巴球明顯增多，多為小到中型、細胞質極少的淋巴球，部分核有缺刻或輪廓不規則（nuclear notching），染色質偏粗但非典型 CLL 的「足球狀」塊狀，需配合 cyclin D1 與 t(11;14) 才能確立被套細胞淋巴瘤（mantle cell lymphoma）。
features: Absolute lymphocytosis with numerous circulating lymphoid cells in a single field
Small to medium-sized lymphocytes with high N:C ratio and scant pale blue cytoplasm
Nuclei round to irregular, some with notches or angulated contours
Moderately condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Mild variation in cell size; one small mature-appearing lymphocyte for comparison
Background red cells unremarkable; no smudge cells or blasts in this field
63673.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a marked lymphocytosis composed of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with scant cytoplasm. The nuclei range from round to irregular, with occasional nuclear notches, and chromatin is moderately condensed without conspicuous nucleoli. There is mild variation in cell size, and smudge cells, prolymphocytes with prominent nucleoli and blasts are not identified in this field; red cells are unremarkable. The morphology indicates a mature B-cell lymphoproliferative disorder, and with CCND1::IGH translocation and cyclin D1 expression, findings are consistent with leukemic mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: CLL cells are small and round with block-like soccer-ball chromatin and frequent smudge cells, and are cyclin D1 negative without t(11;14); CD23 expression here is a potential pitfall.
SMZL cells often show short polar villous cytoplasmic projections and plasmacytoid features and are CD5 and cyclin D1 negative.
Leukemic follicular lymphoma cells are small with deeply cleft (buttock-like) nuclei and are CD10 positive with t(14;18).
Prolymphocytes are medium-sized with a prominent central nucleolus in most cells, and many former B-PLL cases are actually MCL with t(11;14).

63609.recognize_zh: H&E 圖中淡粉紅色類上皮組織球肉芽腫（epithelioid granuloma）旁邊夾雜深染的原始樣淋巴細胞，這些細胞 TdT 核染色與 CD3 皆瀰漫陽性，代表不成熟 T 細胞，即伴肉芽腫的 T 淋巴母細胞白血病／淋巴瘤；CD34 圖以血管內皮陽性為主。
features: H&E: dense infiltrate of small to medium hyperchromatic blast-like lymphoid cells bordering pale eosinophilic epithelioid histiocyte aggregates
TdT: diffuse strong nuclear staining of the infiltrate, sparing the granulomatous area
CD3: diffuse staining of the atypical lymphoid cells
CD34: prominent endothelial staining of vessels; staining of the neoplastic cells is weak or not convincingly demonstrated
Composite of H&E and three immunohistochemical panels on a biopsy core
63609.describe_en: Composite figure of a tissue biopsy. The H&E panel shows a dense infiltrate of hyperchromatic blast-like lymphoid cells admixed with and surrounding aggregates of epithelioid histiocytes forming granulomas. The lymphoid cells are diffusely positive for nuclear TdT and for CD3, indicating an immature T-cell phenotype. In the CD34 panel the endothelium is strongly positive while the neoplastic cells show only weak or equivocal staining, so CD34 positivity described in the legend is not clearly evident in this field. Findings are consistent with T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma accompanied by an epithelioid granulomatous reaction.

ddx.vs: Infectious granulomas are accompanied by mature TdT-negative lymphocytes and often necrosis, with organisms on special stains.
Thymoma has a cytokeratin-positive epithelial meshwork among TdT+ T cells, which is absent in lymphoblastic lymphoma.
Hodgkin lymphoma contains CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells, and the background T cells are TdT-negative.
Lennert lymphoma shows mature CD3+ T cells that lack TdT and CD34.

63481.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中央一顆大型母細胞，核圓、染色質細緻，細胞質深藍無顆粒且邊緣有不規則的泡狀突起（cytoplasmic blebs），旁邊有兩顆小型高核質比細胞與淡藍無顆粒血小板，配合 CML 病史符合巨核母細胞（megakaryoblast）。
features: Large blast with round nucleus, fine dispersed chromatin, and a faint nucleolus
Moderate deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm with irregular angular outline and peripheral blebs
Two smaller cells with very high N:C ratio and scant basophilic cytoplasm (small blasts versus lymphocytes)
Pale, hypogranular platelets in the background
Red cells show crenation and mild anisopoikilocytosis
63481.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large blast with a round nucleus, finely dispersed chromatin, a faint nucleolus, and a rim of deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm with an irregular outline and peripheral cytoplasmic blebs. Two smaller cells with high N:C ratios and scant basophilic cytoplasm are also present, and background platelets are pale and hypogranular. No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules are identified. Morphology alone cannot assign lineage, but in a patient with CML and flow cytometry showing CD41/CD61-positive blasts, findings are consistent with megakaryoblasts in megakaryoblastic blast crisis.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are usually smaller with scant cytoplasm lacking blebs and express TdT with CD19/CD10 or CD3, whereas megakaryoblasts express CD41/CD61.
Myeloblasts may contain azurophilic granules or Auer rods and are MPO positive, while megakaryoblasts are MPO negative and CD41/CD61 positive.
Monoblasts have more abundant gray-blue cytoplasm, folded nuclei, and nonspecific esterase positivity with CD14/CD64 expression.

ddx.dx: Circulating plasma cell or reactive lymphocyte
ddx.vs: Plasma cells have eccentric clumped nuclei with a hof, and reactive lymphocytes have mature chromatin with cytoplasm hugging red cells rather than fine blast chromatin with blebs.

63353.recognize_zh: 視野中多個核染色質散開、形狀不規則的塗抹細胞（smudge cell），與完整的小型淋巴球並存，其中一顆淋巴球有圓形透明的球狀包涵體，符合 CLL。
features: Multiple smudge cells with disrupted, spread-out nuclear chromatin and no intact cytoplasm
Intact small mature lymphocytes with clumped chromatin
One lymphocyte with a round, clear globular cytoplasmic inclusion
Occasional lymphocytes with slightly irregular nuclear outlines due to smearing
Normocytic red cells with rare elongated forms and scattered platelets
63353.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous smudge cells alongside intact small mature lymphocytes with clumped chromatin. One lymphocyte contains a round, clear globular cytoplasmic inclusion. Red cells are normocytic with occasional elongated forms attributable to smear preparation. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia; addition of albumin before smearing can reduce smudging for an accurate differential.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytosis has fewer smudge cells and heterogeneous lymphocytes with abundant cytoplasm rather than a monotonous small-cell population.
MCL cells tend to have more nuclear irregularity and show fewer smudge cells, and they are CD23-negative and cyclin D1-positive.
Smudged blasts come from larger cells with fine chromatin and nucleoli visible in intact cells, which are not present here.

63289.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 骨髓切片中細胞密度高，箭頭所指是核大、染色質呈細顆粒狀開放、帶小核仁的芽細胞，旁邊還可見有絲分裂像，正常成熟造血細胞減少，符合 AML 骨髓浸潤。
features: Hypercellular marrow between adipocytes with many large immature cells (arrows)
Blasts with large round to oval nuclei, finely granular open chromatin, thin nuclear membranes and small nucleoli
Moderate amounts of pale eosinophilic cytoplasm with indistinct borders
Mitotic figure in the lower left field
Scattered small cells with dense nuclei (late erythroid precursors or lymphocytes) and interstitial red cells
63289.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E, high power) shows a hypercellular marrow extensively occupied by large immature cells with round to oval nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli and moderate pale cytoplasm (arrows). A mitotic figure is present, and maturing granulocytic and erythroid elements are reduced to scattered small cells. Megakaryocytes are not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with involvement by acute myeloid leukemia; dysplasia and blast percentage should be assessed on the aspirate with supporting CD34 immunohistochemistry and cytogenetics to classify as myelodysplasia-related.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving marrow
ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are often more pleomorphic with coarser chromatin and prominent nucleoli, and are CD20/PAX5-positive and MPO/CD34-negative.
Myeloma cells have eccentric nuclei with clock-face chromatin, abundant cytoplasm and perinuclear clearing, and are CD138-positive.
MDS-IB retains substantial maturing trilineage hematopoiesis with dysplasia and fewer blasts, requiring blast quantification to separate.

63225.recognize_zh: 這是 von Willebrand 因子多聚體（multimer）膠體電泳圖，第 8–13 道由下（低分子量）往上（高分子量）排成階梯狀條帶；判讀重點是比較左側箭頭所指的高分子量區，看哪幾道缺少大型多聚體。
features: Agarose gel of von Willebrand factor multimers, lanes 8 to 13; smaller multimers migrate to the bottom, larger ones remain near the top
Arrow at left marks the high-molecular-weight multimer region
Lanes 9 to 12 show ladder-like banding extending up into the high-molecular-weight region
Lane 8 and, to a lesser degree, lane 13 show visible lower bands with weak staining at the arrow level
Dense bands at the bottom of most lanes (fainter in lane 9); no legend or control lane, and resolution does not show triplet structure
63225.describe_en: The figure is a von Willebrand factor multimer analysis by gel electrophoresis with six lanes (8-13), in which smaller multimers migrate toward the bottom and larger multimers are retained near the top; the arrow marks the high-molecular-weight region. Lanes 9 through 12 show a ladder of multimers extending into the high-molecular-weight region, whereas lane 8 and, to a lesser extent, lane 13 show preserved lower bands with diminished staining at the arrow level, suggesting relative loss of the largest multimers. Because the figure lacks a legend, a labeled normal control and densitometry, and the resolution does not permit assessment of triplet substructure, lanes cannot be assigned to specific subtypes with certainty. Loss of high-molecular-weight multimers with preserved smaller forms is the pattern of type 2A or 2B von Willebrand disease or acquired von Willebrand syndrome, whereas type 1 shows all multimers in reduced amounts, type 2M a normal distribution, and type 3 essentially no multimers.

ddx.dx: Type 2A vs type 2B von Willebrand disease
ddx.vs: Both lose large multimers on the gel; type 2B shows enhanced ristocetin-induced platelet aggregation at low ristocetin doses and often thrombocytopenia, which the gel alone cannot show.
Can reproduce a 2A-like loss of large multimers (aortic stenosis, LVAD, MGUS, myeloproliferative neoplasms); history, VWF propeptide ratio and correction after treating the cause separate it.

ddx.dx: Type 1 or type 2M von Willebrand disease
ddx.vs: Both show a normal multimer distribution, with uniformly reduced intensity in type 1 and a disproportionately low activity-to-antigen ratio in type 2M.

63097.recognize_zh: 下方中央一顆巨噬細胞的細胞質內擠滿許多小卵圓形小體，周圍也有散在的細胞外小體，每個小體有核與棒狀動基體（kinetoplast）；巨噬細胞內含 LD bodies 是內臟型利什曼病的診斷線索。
features: Macrophage with abundant pale cytoplasm packed with numerous small oval amastigotes
Amastigotes about 2-4 um, each with a nucleus and a small rod-like kinetoplast
Additional extracellular amastigotes scattered around the macrophage
Background multilineage hematopoiesis: erythroid precursors, myelocytes, band neutrophils
Occasional plasma cells in the background
63097.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a macrophage whose cytoplasm is filled with numerous small oval amastigotes, each bearing a nucleus and a rod-shaped kinetoplast, with additional extracellular organisms nearby. The background shows maturing erythroid and granulocytic precursors with occasional plasma cells. Findings are consistent with visceral leishmaniasis.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts in macrophages show a surrounding clear halo, stain with GMS/PAS and lack a kinetoplast.
T. marneffei yeasts divide by central transverse septation and lack a kinetoplast.
Storage histiocytes contain granular or striated material, not discrete organisms with nuclei and kinetoplasts.
Engulfed platelets are irregular granular fragments without the paired nucleus-kinetoplast structure.

63033.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的是一個大型紅系前驅細胞，核內有淡紫到嗜伊紅性、毛玻璃樣的大包涵體，染色質被推擠到核膜邊緣形成一圈暗環（燈籠細胞 lantern cell），是 Parvovirus B19 的核內包涵體。
features: Enlarged early erythroid precursor (arrow) with a large round nucleus
Glassy, pale lavender-eosinophilic intranuclear inclusion occupying most of the nucleus
Chromatin marginated against the nuclear membrane forming a dark rim with a perinuclear clear halo
Surrounding marrow with granulocytic precursors, hemosiderin-laden macrophages and adipocytes
Adjacent sinusoid with edematous/proteinaceous material; scale bar 20 um
63033.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy section at high power shows an enlarged early erythroid precursor containing a large glassy, pale eosinophilic intranuclear inclusion with chromatin margination along the nuclear membrane. The surrounding marrow contains granulocytic precursors, scattered hemosiderin-laden macrophages and fat, while maturing erythroid islands are not conspicuous in this field. Only a single inclusion-bearing cell is evident here. Findings are consistent with parvovirus B19 cytopathic effect; parvovirus immunohistochemistry, serology or PCR is recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: CMV causes cytomegaly in endothelial/stromal cells with a dense owl's-eye inclusion and granular cytoplasmic inclusions, whereas parvovirus targets erythroid precursors with glassy nuclear inclusions.
HSV shows multinucleation, nuclear molding and chromatin margination in epithelial cells, which are absent in marrow erythroid cells.
Megaloblasts have open, sieve-like chromatin without a discrete homogeneous intranuclear inclusion.
Leukemic proerythroblasts form sheets with nucleoli and lack glassy inclusions or chromatin margination.

62969.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中散在許多紅血球前驅細胞，以胞質深藍的早期型（前紅血球母細胞、嗜鹼性紅血球母細胞）偏多，其中數個細胞胞質內有空泡，這種紅系左移加胞質空泡化屬於紅系造血異常（dyserythropoiesis）的線索；但本圖倍率低，細部異常難以完整評估。
features: Scattered erythroid precursors with a relative excess of early forms (pronormoblasts and basophilic normoblasts)
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm in early erythroid cells, some with cytoplasmic vacuoles
Round nuclei with fine to moderately condensed chromatin
Few granulocytic cells and small lymphocytes interspersed; hemodilute red cell background
Low magnification limits assessment of nuclear budding, internuclear bridging or megaloblastoid change
62969.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Wright-Giemsa, low-intermediate power) is partially hemodilute and contains scattered erythroid precursors with a left shift toward pronormoblasts and basophilic normoblasts. Several early erythroid cells show deeply basophilic cytoplasm with vacuolation. Granulocytic cells are present in small numbers, and blasts are not obviously increased in this field. Assessment of other dyserythropoietic features is limited by magnification. The findings are suggestive of dyserythropoiesis with erythroid left shift and vacuolation; causes such as copper deficiency, alcohol, zinc toxicity, drugs (e.g., linezolid, chloramphenicol) and myelodysplastic neoplasm should be considered.

ddx.vs: MDS requires dysplasia in at least 10% of cells of a lineage, often with ring sideroblasts, megaloblastoid change and clonal cytogenetic/molecular abnormalities, rather than isolated vacuolation.
Copper deficiency shows vacuolated erythroid and myeloid precursors with ring sideroblasts and neutropenia, reversing with copper replacement.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows at least 80% erythroid cells with at least 30% pronormoblasts, often with vacuolated deeply basophilic cytoplasm in sheets, far exceeding this field.
Parvovirus produces giant pronormoblasts with intranuclear inclusions and absent later erythroid forms, not a vacuolated left shift across stages.

62905.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中三個嗜中性球的細胞質內可見粗大、深紫黑色的團塊狀顆粒，常偏聚在細胞一側或覆蓋分葉核，背景紅血球有許多皺縮細胞（echinocytes）；結合注射碘造影劑後採血的病史，判讀為嗜中性球內色素。
features: Three neutrophils, each with a segmented or band-like nucleus
Coarse, clumped dark purple-black granular material in the cytoplasm, focally aggregated at one pole or overlying the nucleus
Residual fine pink neutrophilic granules visible between the dark clumps
Numerous echinocytes (crenated red cells) and scattered platelets in background
No blasts, parasites, or intracellular organisms identified
62905.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows three neutrophils containing coarse, clumped dark purple-black cytoplasmic granular material, focally aggregated and partly overlying the nuclear lobes, with residual fine neutrophilic granules in the remaining cytoplasm. Red cells are normochromic with numerous echinocytes, and platelets are present. No intracellular organisms or blasts are seen. In a septic patient sampled after iodinated contrast administration, findings are consistent with ingested pigment in neutrophils superimposed on toxic granulation.

ddx.vs: Toxic granules are evenly distributed dark azurophilic granules rather than irregular black clumps aggregated at one pole.
Basophils have granules of uniform size diffusely covering the nucleus, without residual pink neutrophilic granules or a neutrophil-type segmented nucleus visible beneath.
Constitutional dark granules present uniformly in all granulocytes and often lymphocytes, not an acquired finding after contrast exposure.
Organisms have defined shapes (cocci, rods, or yeast with halo) rather than amorphous granular clumps.

62841.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片（trephine）中，骨小樑之間幾乎被紫藍色的造血細胞填滿，只剩少數小脂肪空泡，屬於明顯高細胞密度（hypercellular）骨髓；單看這張低倍圖無法判斷細胞種類，需要搭配免疫染色才能確認骨髓瘤。
features: Low-power H&E view of an intact bone marrow trephine core with multiple bony trabeculae
Intertrabecular spaces markedly hypercellular, filled by sheets of hematopoietic/infiltrating cells
Adipocytes reduced to small scattered vacuoles; no large fat spaces
Trabeculae of roughly normal thickness without obvious lytic scalloping at this magnification
Cell lineage and plasma cell content cannot be assessed at this power
62841.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of a bone marrow trephine biopsy shows an adequate core with numerous bony trabeculae. The intertrabecular spaces are markedly hypercellular with only small, scattered fat vacuoles, indicating near-complete loss of normal marrow fat for age. Cellular composition cannot be resolved at this magnification, and high-power examination with immunohistochemistry (e.g., CD138, light chains) is required. In the stated clinical context, the findings are consistent with a hypercellular marrow involved by plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.vs: Reactive marrow shows trilineage hematopoiesis with normal maturation and no clonal plasma cell clusters on CD138 and kappa/lambda staining.
MPNs show panmyelosis with atypical clustered megakaryocytes and often reticulin fibrosis rather than a CD138-positive, light chain-restricted plasma cell infiltrate.
Acute leukemia replaces the marrow with sheets of blasts (CD34/CD117/TdT positive) rather than mature-appearing plasma cells.

62777.recognize_zh: 淋巴結呈濾泡狀結構，濾泡內為 CD20+、CD10+ 的 B 細胞並有 CD21 陽性濾泡樹突細胞網；FISH 同時看到 IGH::BCL2 融合訊號與 MYC 分離訊號（箭頭），代表具 MYC 與 BCL2 重排的「雙打擊」濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Lymph node with vaguely nodular/follicular architecture at low power
Follicles composed of fairly monotonous medium-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei and small nucleoli
CD20-positive, CD10-positive neoplastic B cells filling the follicles; CD3-positive T cells mainly interfollicular
CD21 highlights expanded follicular dendritic cell meshworks
FISH: IGH::BCL2 fusion signals and separated MYC break-apart signals (arrows)
62777.describe_en: Lymph node sections show a vaguely nodular follicular proliferation that is composed of fairly monotonous medium-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei. The neoplastic follicles are CD20- and CD10-positive with CD21-positive follicular dendritic cell meshworks, while CD3-positive T cells are largely interfollicular. FISH demonstrates IGH::BCL2 fusion signals and MYC rearrangement by break-apart probe. Findings are consistent with a follicular-pattern B-cell lymphoma harboring both MYC and BCL2 rearrangements; grading and correlation with any diffuse areas are required, as such cases may qualify as high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements.

ddx.vs: Morphology may be identical, so separation requires FISH showing absence of MYC rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma/high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: These show a diffuse growth pattern with loss of follicular dendritic cell meshworks, whereas this case retains a CD21-positive follicular architecture.
Reactive germinal centers are BCL2-negative, polarized with tingible body macrophages, and lack IGH::BCL2 fusion.
Burkitt lymphoma has diffuse starry-sky growth, near-100% Ki-67, BCL2 negativity, and MYC rearrangement without BCL2 translocation.

62777.stain: H&E; IHC: CD20, CD3, CD10, CD21; FISH

62713.recognize_zh: 母細胞 gate 的 CD33 對 CD58 流式圖：幾乎所有母細胞 CD58 均一強陽性（約 10^4–10^5），CD33 從陰性到約 5×10^4 連續性表現，呈斜向延伸的單一大族群。
features: Dot plot gated on blasts: CD33-PC5.5 (x) versus CD58-FITC (y), log scales
Single dominant population with uniformly bright CD58 (~10^4 to 10^5)
CD33 expression heterogeneous, from negative to moderately bright (~5 x 10^4)
Slight positive diagonal: CD33-brighter cells also brighter for CD58
Minor tail of CD58-dimmer cells (~10^3.5), few in number
62713.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of the blast gate displays CD33 versus CD58. The blasts form a single dominant population with uniformly bright CD58 and heterogeneous CD33 expression ranging from negative to moderately bright. Bright CD58 is a leukemia-associated feature used for B-lymphoblast detection and MRD, while CD33 is myeloid-associated but not lineage defining. Findings are compatible with the immunophenotype of the reported mixed phenotype acute leukemia, B/myeloid, which requires MPO (or monocytic differentiation) plus strong CD19 with other B markers.

ddx.vs: CD33 is common in B-ALL; B/myeloid MPAL requires additional myeloid lineage evidence such as MPO positivity by flow or cytochemistry.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with aberrant CD19
ddx.vs: In AML (e.g., with t(8;21)) CD19 is typically weak without strong CD79a/CD22/CD10, which fails B-lineage criteria.
Normal B-cell precursors show a maturational continuum with normal CD58 intensity and no CD33, unlike this uniform bright CD58, CD33-positive population.

62585.recognize_zh: 極低倍 H&E：淋巴結正常結構被大量大小相近、背靠背（back-to-back）緊密排列的結節取代，結節間僅有少量淡粉紅色濾泡間組織，並延伸到被膜附近；這是濾泡性淋巴瘤的結節性生長模式，分級需在高倍計數中心母細胞。
features: Effacement of nodal architecture by numerous closely packed nodules
Nodules of relatively uniform size and shape arranged back-to-back
Attenuated or indistinct mantle zones with little intervening interfollicular tissue
Nodules extend throughout the node including near the capsule
Grade cannot be assessed at this magnification
62585.describe_en: Lymph node at very low power shows effacement of the normal architecture by numerous closely packed, back-to-back nodules of fairly uniform size, distributed evenly throughout the node including the periphery. Mantle zones are attenuated and the interfollicular tissue is scant. No sinuses or reactive polarized germinal centers are appreciated. The follicular growth pattern is consistent with follicular lymphoma; histologic grading (grade 3a in this case) requires high-power assessment of centroblasts per high-power field.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles vary in size and shape, are mostly cortical with preserved sinuses and intact mantle zones, and show polarization with tingible body macrophages.
Nodular MCL consists of monotonous small cells with irregular nuclei, cyclin D1/SOX11 positive, and lacks true germinal-center cell composition.
NMZL shows pale marginal zone and monocytoid cells around residual follicles with colonized germinal centers and is CD10/BCL6 negative.
NLPHL nodules are larger and less uniform, composed of small lymphocytes with scattered LP cells rather than centrocytes and centroblasts.

62521.recognize_zh: 高倍下左側為淡染、細顆粒狀的壞死區，右側為呈柵欄狀排列的上皮樣組織球（核呈卵圓或拖鞋形、染色質細緻）與纖維化基質；這是壞死性肉芽腫邊緣，符合貓抓病的組織反應。
features: Epithelioid histiocytes with elongated, oval to slipper-shaped nuclei and fine chromatin, palisading toward necrosis
Adjacent pale, finely granular and vacuolated necrotic material with scattered karyorrhectic debris
Collagenous fibrous tissue at the outer aspect of the histiocytic rim
Few intact neutrophils or lymphocytes in this field; organisms are not visible on H&E
62521.describe_en: High-power H&E shows a zone of pale, finely granular and vacuolated necrotic debris with scattered nuclear dust, bordered by a rim of epithelioid histiocytes with elongated to slipper-shaped nuclei and fine chromatin arranged in a palisading pattern. Collagenous fibrous tissue lies outside the histiocytic layer. No organisms are identifiable on H&E, and there is no cytologic atypia. Findings represent the edge of a necrotizing granuloma and, in the appropriate clinical context, are consistent with cat scratch disease; a Warthin-Starry or Steiner stain, Bartonella serology or PCR can support the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Tuberculosis shows caseous necrosis without neutrophilic microabscesses, often with Langhans giant cells, and acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain.
These also form stellate suppurative granulomas and are separated by clinical exposure, serology or culture rather than morphology.
Histoplasma or other fungi are demonstrated by GMS/PAS stains within histiocytes or necrosis.
Kikuchi necrosis lacks neutrophils and well-formed palisading granulomas and contains crescentic histiocytes and plasmacytoid dendritic cells.

62457.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀 CD3 對側向散射（SSC）圖，gate 在活細胞：低 SSC 的 CD3 陽性 T 細胞佔 60.90%，明顯增加；其中藍色（異常 CD4 dim 族群）的 CD3 強度略低於綠色（殘存正常 CD4 T 細胞），提示周邊血有大量異常 T 細胞。
features: Dot plot of side scatter (SS INT) versus CD3-PC7, gated on live cells
Large CD3-positive, low side-scatter population comprising 60.90% of live events
Color-coded subsets within the CD3 gate: blue events sit at slightly lower CD3 intensity than green events
CD3-negative events with a broad side-scatter range represent granulocytes, monocytes and other non-T cells
Non-morphologic figure; interpretation depends on back-gating colors from companion CD4, CD7 and CD26 plots
62457.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of side scatter versus CD3 on live peripheral blood cells shows a CD3-positive, low side-scatter T-cell population accounting for 60.90% of live events, indicating a marked T-cell expansion. Within this gate, the population painted blue (the CD4-dim abnormal population defined in companion plots) shows slightly dimmer CD3 expression than the green residual normal CD4-positive T cells. The CD3-negative events represent granulocytes, monocytes and other non-T cells. In conjunction with the CD4, CD7 and CD26 plots, the findings support circulating neoplastic T cells of mycosis fungoides/Sezary syndrome.

ddx.vs: Reactive T-cell expansions retain normal CD3 intensity and a mixed CD4/CD8 population without CD7 or CD26 loss.
T-LGL is usually CD8-positive with CD57/CD16 expression, unlike the CD4-positive population in this case.
T-PLL often shows very high counts with CD7 retained and TCL1 expression, while dim surface CD3 and CD7/CD26 loss favor Sezary cells.

62393.recognize_zh: 低倍下可見多個反應性濾泡，IgG 免疫染色在生發中心（germinal center）內及濾泡間區都有大量棕色陽性漿細胞，提示 IgG4 相關淋巴結病變的背景，但仍需 IgG4 染色計算 IgG4/IgG 比值。
features: Multiple round reactive lymphoid follicles with intact mantle zones at low power
Numerous IgG-positive cells (cytoplasmic brown staining) clustered within germinal centers
Abundant scattered IgG-positive plasma cells in the interfollicular region
Mantle zones largely devoid of IgG-positive cells
Preserved nodal architecture without sheets of atypical cells
62393.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for IgG on a lymph node section shows preserved architecture with multiple reactive follicles. There are markedly increased IgG-positive plasma cells within germinal centers and scattered throughout the interfollicular areas, while mantle zones are largely spared. An accompanying IgG4 stain is required to determine the IgG4-positive cell count and IgG4/IgG ratio. In the appropriate context, findings are suggestive of IgG4-related lymphadenopathy (follicular hyperplasia-type pattern).

ddx.vs: Intragerminal-center plasma cells are uncommon in ordinary reactive hyperplasia, and the IgG4/IgG ratio is typically below 40%.

Castleman disease shows sheets of interfollicular plasma cells with regressed or hyaline-vascular follicles and often HHV-8 or IL-6 driven systemic features, and may also have high IgG4 counts, requiring clinicopathologic correlation.

ddx.dx: Nodal marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Lymphoma shows light-chain-restricted plasma cells on kappa/lambda staining and expansion of monocytoid B cells, whereas IgG4-related disease is polytypic.

62329.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中有大量中至大型淋巴樣細胞，細胞質淡藍且量中等、邊緣不規則略呈毛絨狀突起，核圓至卵圓、染色質中度凝集並常見一個明顯中央核仁（類前淋巴球 prolymphocyte-like），提示 B 細胞淋巴瘤周邊血侵犯，如邊緣區淋巴瘤。
features: Numerous medium to large lymphoid cells, about 2 times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Moderate N:C ratio with moderate pale blue-gray cytoplasm
Irregular, focally shaggy cytoplasmic borders with short projections, often polar rather than circumferential
Round to oval nuclei, some slightly indented, with moderately condensed chromatin
Single distinct central nucleolus in many cells (prolymphocyte-like)
Red cells unremarkable; no smudge cells or granular lymphocytes evident
62329.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a marked population of medium to large atypical lymphoid cells. The cells have moderate amounts of pale blue-gray cytoplasm with irregular, focally shaggy borders and short, partly polar projections, and round to oval nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin and a single distinct nucleolus in many cells. Background red cells are unremarkable. The morphology is that of circulating prolymphocyte-like B cells; in the context of the known diagnosis, findings are consistent with leukemic involvement by marginal zone lymphoma, with flow cytometry needed to exclude hairy cell leukemia and its variants.

ddx.vs: HCL cells have circumferential fine hairy projections, oval or bean-shaped nuclei with homogeneous chromatin and usually no nucleolus, with CD11c/CD25/CD103/CD123 and BRAF V600E positivity.

ddx.dx: Splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli (HCL variant)
ddx.vs: This entity combines villous cytoplasm with a prominent nucleolus similar to these cells, but is CD25-negative/CD103-positive, whereas SMZL is typically CD103-negative and CD25 variable.
MCL cells have scant cytoplasm without villous projections and are CD5-positive with cyclin D1/SOX11 expression and t(11;14).

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia with increased prolymphocytes
ddx.vs: CLL shows small mature lymphocytes with clumped chromatin, scant cytoplasm and smudge cells, with a CD5+/CD23+/dim sIg phenotype.

62265.recognize_zh: 這是一支離心後的玻璃管照片：深紅色紅血球層、琥珀黃色血漿層分層清楚，交界處可見少量紅色顆粒；照片本身無法直接看到緡錢狀排列（rouleaux），需搭配抹片才能判讀骨髓瘤相關的紅血球緡錢狀。
features: Gross photograph of a small glass tube after centrifugation, photographed inverted with the sealed end uppermost
Dark red packed red cell column occupying the sealed end
Clear amber-yellow supernatant plasma layer without visible hemolysis
Few small red flecks/aggregates at the lower plasma interface, possibly agglutinated cells
Individual rouleaux cannot be resolved at this macroscopic level
62265.describe_en: The image is a gross photograph of a centrifuged glass tube showing a dark red packed red cell layer and an overlying clear amber-yellow plasma layer, with a few small red flecks at the plasma interface that may represent aggregated red cells. The plasma is not visibly hemolyzed. Rouleaux formation is a microscopic finding and cannot be confirmed from this macroscopic image; it requires a peripheral smear or wet preparation, where rouleaux disperse with saline dilution whereas true agglutination persists. The image is therefore only partially illustrative of the stated rouleaux in multiple myeloma and should be correlated with the blood film, ESR and serum protein electrophoresis.

ddx.vs: Cold agglutinins cause clumps that persist after saline replacement but disperse on warming to 37 C, unlike rouleaux, which disperse with saline dilution.
Inflammatory states produce milder rouleaux with an elevated ESR but no monoclonal protein on electrophoresis.
Lipemic plasma appears milky and icteric plasma is deep yellow-green, which changes plasma color without red cell aggregation.

62201.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中散見兩端尖細、呈新月形或梭形的紅血球（sickle cell），夾在一般圓形紅血球之間；本片染色偏灰、對焦略模糊，但細長尖端的鐮刀狀外形仍可辨認。
features: Scattered elongated, crescent- to spindle-shaped red cells with pointed ends (sickle cells)
Occasional boat-shaped/oat cells and a few irregularly dense red cells
Background of round red cells, some with central pallor
No nucleated cells or Howell-Jolly bodies identifiable in this field
Suboptimal staining (grey-green hue) and focus limit assessment of target cells and inclusions
62201.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered irreversibly sickled red cells with elongated crescent shapes and pointed ends, together with occasional boat-shaped cells, among otherwise round red cells. No white cells, nucleated red cells or Howell-Jolly bodies are seen in this field. The smear is suboptimally stained and slightly out of focus, which limits evaluation of target cells and polychromasia. Findings are consistent with a sickling disorder such as sickle cell anemia; hemoglobin electrophoresis or HPLC is required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: HbSC smears show many target cells, fewer classic sickle cells and characteristic HbC crystals with blunt 'washington monument' shapes, confirmed by electrophoresis.
Elliptocytes are oval with parallel sides and rounded ends rather than tapering pointed ends.
Artifactual elongated cells are oriented in the same direction in one smear area, whereas true sickle cells are randomly oriented and have pointed tips.

62073.recognize_zh: 組合圖中周邊血紅血球小球性低色素且大小形狀不一（A），嗜中性球核分葉異常（B）；超活體 brilliant cresyl blue 染色見布滿細點狀包涵體的「高爾夫球」細胞（HbH，C）；骨髓抹片（E–G）有紅血球系與骨髓系發育異常，鐵染色（H、I）見鐵顆粒，提示 MDS 合併後天性 α 地中海貧血。
features: A-B (PB): microcytic hypochromic red cells with anisopoikilocytosis; neutrophils with abnormal nuclear segmentation/clumped chromatin
C (brilliant cresyl blue supravital stain): scattered red cells with numerous fine, evenly distributed golf-ball inclusions (HbH precipitates)
D: test strip/immunochromatographic or electrophoresis-type assay image (details not interpretable at this resolution)
E-G (BM aspirate): dysplastic erythroid precursors including multinucleated/megaloblastoid forms and dysplastic myeloid cells
H-I (iron stain): erythroid precursors with coarse perinuclear siderotic granules
Low-resolution composite limits quantitative assessment of dysplasia
62073.describe_en: This composite includes peripheral blood, supravital, and bone marrow images. The peripheral smear shows microcytic, hypochromic red cells with anisopoikilocytosis and neutrophils with abnormal nuclear segmentation, and brilliant cresyl blue supravital staining demonstrates red cells with numerous fine golf-ball inclusions characteristic of HbH. Bone marrow aspirate panels show dyserythropoiesis with multinucleated and megaloblastoid erythroid precursors and dysplastic myeloid cells, and the iron stain highlights erythroid precursors with coarse siderotic granules, raising the possibility of ring sideroblasts. Panel D appears to be a strip-based assay whose details cannot be read at this resolution. Findings are consistent with acquired HbH disease (alpha-thalassemia myelodysplastic syndrome), classically associated with somatic ATRX mutations in MDS.

ddx.vs: Inherited HbH disease has lifelong microcytosis with alpha-globin gene deletions and no marrow dysplasia, whereas the acquired form arises in older patients with MDS and ATRX mutation.

ddx.dx: MDS with ring sideroblasts without alpha-thalassemia
ddx.vs: MDS-RS may also show microcytic/dimorphic red cells but lacks HbH golf-ball inclusions and HbH on HPLC.
Iron deficiency shows absent marrow iron and no HbH inclusions or dysplasia.

62073.stain: Wright-Giemsa; brilliant cresyl blue; Prussian blue

62009.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中多顆顆粒球細胞質淡而顆粒稀少，核呈雙葉或分葉不良（類 Pelger 樣），部分晚期顆粒球的染色質過度粗塊；顆粒減少加上核分葉異常，是 MDS 顆粒球系發育不良的典型表現。
features: Several neutrophils with bilobed or hyposegmented nuclei (pseudo-Pelger-Huet change)
Hypogranular to agranular pale grey cytoplasm in maturing granulocytes
Coarsely clumped chromatin in hyposegmented forms
Occasional myelocytes/metamyelocytes with reduced granulation
Crushed/smudged cells and red cells with drying artifact in background
62009.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows maturing granulocytes with frequent hypogranular cytoplasm and abnormal nuclear segmentation, including bilobed and hyposegmented pseudo-Pelger-Huet forms with coarsely clumped chromatin. Occasional crushed cells and drying artifact are present. Blasts are not increased in this field. The findings are consistent with dysgranulopoiesis, supporting a myelodysplastic neoplasm in keeping with MDS with ring sideroblasts and multilineage dysplasia; quantification (≥10% dysplastic cells) requires a full differential count.

ddx.dx: Drug- or toxin-induced dysgranulopoiesis (e.g., mycophenolate, G-CSF, HIV)
ddx.vs: Similar changes can be reactive; clinical history and persistence, cytogenetics or SF3B1 mutation are needed to establish MDS.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes
ddx.vs: AML-MR requires ≥20% blasts, which are not seen in this field.
Inherited anomaly has normally granulated neutrophils with uniform hyposegmentation and no cytopenia.

61945.recognize_zh: CD3 免疫染色中，大量小型 T 細胞呈細胞膜陽性並填滿濾泡間區，中間夾著數個 CD3 陰性（藍色）的小細胞區，對應 B 細胞濾泡或 B 細胞區；T 區擴張而結構保留，符合 EBV 再活化時的反應性副皮質增生。
features: Lymphoid tissue with numerous CD3-positive small T cells showing membranous staining
Expanded interfollicular/paracortical T-cell zones
Intervening CD3-negative zones of small lymphocytes, consistent with B-cell areas or follicles
Positive cells are small and uniform without large atypical T cells evident at this power
Overall compartmentalization of T- and B-cell zones is preserved
61945.describe_en: CD3 immunostain on lymphoid tissue shows numerous small T cells with membranous staining occupying expanded interfollicular and paracortical areas, separating CD3-negative zones of small lymphocytes that likely represent B-cell areas. The T cells are small and uniform without obvious large atypical forms at this magnification, and the compartmentalization of T- and B-cell zones is preserved. Findings are consistent with a reactive paracortical T-cell expansion, as seen in EBV reactivation, and do not by themselves indicate a T-cell lymphoma; EBER ISH and correlation with CD20, CD30 and clonality studies are required.

ddx.vs: PTCL effaces the architecture with atypical medium to large T cells, often with pan-T antigen loss and a clonal TCR rearrangement.
AITL shows expanded CD21+ follicular dendritic meshworks, arborizing vessels and atypical PD-1/CD10-positive TFH cells, often with scattered EBV-positive B blasts.
