Hodgkin lymphoma contains CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells rosetted by T cells within an expanded interfollicular zone.

61881.recognize_zh: 漿膜腔積液中大量嗜中性球背景下，出現吞噬多個嗜中性球的大型細胞，其胞質深藍、形態近似反應性間皮細胞；免疫染色 calretinin 陽性而 CD163 陰性，證實是具吞噬能力的間皮細胞而非巨噬細胞。
features: Neutrophil-rich serous effusion background
Large cell with dense deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing multiple engulfed neutrophils (phagocytosing mesothelial cell)
Adjacent smaller reactive mesothelial cell with round nucleus and basophilic cytoplasm, and a pale vacuolated macrophage for comparison
Cell block with large cells containing phagocytosed neutrophils (circled)
Phagocytic cell calretinin positive and CD163 negative, whereas surrounding macrophages are CD163 positive
61881.describe_en: Composite of a serous effusion specimen. The cytospin (A) shows a neutrophil-rich background with a large cell bearing dense basophilic cytoplasm that contains several engulfed neutrophils, alongside a reactive mesothelial cell and a paler macrophage for comparison. The cell block section (B) shows similar large cells with intracytoplasmic neutrophils (circled). Immunohistochemistry demonstrates that the phagocytic cell is calretinin positive (C) and CD163 negative (D), while background macrophages are CD163 positive. Findings are consistent with reactive mesothelial cells showing phagocytic activity in an acute inflammatory (septic) effusion; no malignant cells are evident.

ddx.vs: Macrophages have pale, foamy or vacuolated cytoplasm and are CD163/CD68 positive and calretinin negative, the opposite of this cell's profile.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters with nuclear atypia and express epithelial markers (MOC31, BerEP4, claudin-4) rather than calretinin.
Mesothelioma shows large atypical clusters/morulae with BAP1 loss or CDKN2A deletion, whereas these are isolated reactive mesothelial cells in an inflammatory background.
Hemophagocytic cells engulf red cells, platelets and nucleated hematopoietic cells and are CD163 positive, typically in HLH, rather than a calretinin-positive cell engulfing neutrophils.

61817.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有多顆大型單核球系細胞，核呈摺疊、扭曲或腎形，染色質細緻，細胞質灰藍；並見顆粒稀少的顆粒球系細胞，屬於單核球系增生合併發育不良的表現。
features: Large monocytoid cells with folded, convoluted or reniform nuclei and delicate chromatin
Occasional large immature cells with fine chromatin and faint nucleoli (promonocyte/blast range)
Abundant grey-blue to grey-pink cytoplasm, some with fine vacuoles
Hypogranular granulocytic cells with abnormal nuclear segmentation
Small lymphocytes, red cells and an adipocyte vacuole at lower left
61817.describe_en: Wright-Giemsa-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of large monocytic cells with folded, convoluted and reniform nuclei, delicate chromatin and abundant grey-blue cytoplasm. Some cells have fine chromatin with faint nucleoli, falling into the promonocyte or blast range, and admixed granulocytic cells show reduced granulation and irregular segmentation. Promonocytes should be counted as blast equivalents on a formal differential. Findings are consistent with a myeloid neoplasm with monocytic proliferation and dysplasia, such as CMML, in the setting of germline GATA2 mutation.

ddx.vs: Requires at least 20% monoblasts plus promonocytes with round-to-folded nuclei and prominent nucleoli, while this field includes many mature-appearing monocytes.
Reactive monocytes lack accompanying dysgranulopoiesis and immature promonocytes.
Lymphoid precursors have scant cytoplasm without the abundant grey-blue vacuolated cytoplasm and nuclear folding seen here.

61753.recognize_zh: 脾臟 H&E 可見密集、單調的小到中型淋巴細胞，核圓、細胞質中等偏淡或略呈漿細胞樣，浸潤於充血的紅髓與血管周圍；單一形態 B 細胞取代正常脾組織，搭配免疫染色支持脾邊緣區淋巴瘤。
features: Dense, monotonous infiltrate of small to intermediate lymphoid cells
Round nuclei with condensed to slightly open chromatin; occasional small nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale to amphophilic cytoplasm, some cells with plasmacytoid features
Infiltrate extends through congested red pulp with numerous red blood cells
Vessel with hyalinized wall in the right field
61753.describe_en: Sections of spleen show a dense infiltrate of monotonous small to intermediate lymphoid cells with round nuclei, moderate pale to amphophilic cytoplasm, and focal plasmacytoid features, extending into congested red pulp and around a thick-walled vessel. Mitotic figures are not conspicuous, and no large cell sheets are identified in this field. Nodular white pulp architecture cannot be assessed at this magnification. In conjunction with the B-cell immunophenotype, findings are consistent with splenic marginal zone lymphoma.

ddx.vs: HCL cells have abundant clear cytoplasm with 'fried egg' spacing, form red cell lakes, and are annexin A1-, CD103- and BRAF V600E-positive.
LPL shows more prominent plasmacytic differentiation with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P, which is uncommon in SMZL.
MCL cells have scant cytoplasm and irregular nuclei and are CD5- and cyclin D1-positive.

61689.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散點圖（TCRαβ 對 CD3，活細胞閘門），非形態影像；主要藍色族群為 CD3 強陽性並表現 TCRαβ，顯示擴增的是 αβ 型 T 細胞，灰色族群為 CD3 陰性細胞。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot, TCRab-PE (x-axis) versus CD3-PC7 (y-axis), gated on [Live Cells]
Dominant blue population with bright CD3 (about 10^2) and TCR alpha/beta expression ranging from dim to about 10^1
Small red cluster with brighter CD3 and TCR alpha/beta at the upper right of the main population
Red and blue events with dimmer CD3 trailing downward at lower TCR alpha/beta intensity
Large grey CD3-negative, TCR alpha/beta-negative population representing non-T cells
61689.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of live cells displays TCR alpha/beta versus CD3 expression. The dominant CD3-positive population (blue) expresses surface TCR alpha/beta, although with a broad range of intensity that is somewhat dimmer than a small red CD3-bright, TCR alpha/beta-bright subset. CD3-negative events (grey) represent granulocytes, monocytes, B and NK cells. The findings indicate an expanded alpha/beta T-cell population, as expected in T-prolymphocytic leukemia, which is almost always of alpha/beta lineage.

61497.recognize_zh: 拼圖中周邊血與骨髓的中性球、單核球及組織球細胞質內塞滿許多大小一致（約 2–4 µm）的橢圓形酵母樣小體，每顆周圍有透明暈圈、偏心的染色質點；F 圖痰液 PAS 染色可見窄基出芽的橢圓酵母，符合莢膜組織漿菌（Histoplasma capsulatum）播散性感染。
features: Composite figure (panels A-F): neutrophils/monocytes (A-D) and marrow histiocytes (E) packed with numerous small uniform oval yeast forms
Yeasts about 2-4 um with a clear halo (retraction from a poorly stained wall) and a small eccentric crescent of chromatin
Intracellular organisms fill cytoplasmic vacuoles and displace the host nucleus; no kinetoplast visible
Panel C shows a heavily parasitized cell with densely packed basophilic yeasts
Panel F (sputum, PAS): magenta oval yeast cells with occasional narrow-based budding
Peripheral blood background of red cells and segmented neutrophils; resolution limits fine nuclear detail
61497.describe_en: This composite figure shows peripheral blood (A-D) and bone marrow aspirate (E) smears in which occasional neutrophils, monocytes and histiocytes contain numerous intracytoplasmic, small, uniform oval yeast-like organisms. Each organism is surrounded by a clear halo representing retraction from a poorly staining cell wall, with a small eccentric chromatin dot; no kinetoplast is identified. Panel F shows a PAS-stained sputum smear with oval, narrow-based budding yeasts. Findings are consistent with disseminated histoplasmosis (Histoplasma capsulatum), to be confirmed by fungal culture, antigen testing or tissue stains (GMS/PAS).

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes have a nucleus plus a rod-shaped kinetoplast and lack the clear halo and budding seen with Histoplasma.
Talaromyces yeasts are more elongated/sausage-shaped and divide by fission with a central transverse septum rather than narrow-based budding.
Candida yeasts are larger, stain strongly without a halo, and often form pseudohyphae.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescent-shaped with a central nucleus and do not bud or show a halo.

61433.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中大量大型母細胞，胞質豐富、呈灰藍色，核圓形至輕度折疊、染色質細緻並可見核仁，符合單核母細胞/前單核球型態，提示急性單核球性白血病。
features: Numerous large blasts with abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm and low-moderate N:C ratio
Round to oval nuclei, some gently folded or indented, eccentrically placed
Fine, lacy chromatin with one or more visible nucleoli
Cytoplasm largely agranular, with occasional small vacuoles; no Auer rods seen
Several bare/disrupted nuclei with speckled chromatin; background red cells without other lineages prominent
61433.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous circulating large blasts with abundant grey-blue, largely agranular cytoplasm, occasional fine vacuoles, and round to gently folded nuclei with fine chromatin and prominent nucleoli. Scattered disrupted cells are present. Auer rods and dysplastic granulocytes are not seen in this field. The morphology is that of monoblasts and promonocytes, and findings are consistent with acute monoblastic/monocytic leukemia; confirmation by nonspecific esterase cytochemistry and flow cytometry is recommended.

ddx.vs: APL cells have bilobed/sliding-plate nuclei with fine granules and are strongly MPO-positive and CD34/HLA-DR-negative, whereas monoblasts are MPO-weak/negative and NSE-positive.
CMML shows mature monocytes with clumped chromatin and <20% blasts plus promonocytes, unlike this field dominated by blasts.
Lymphoblasts are smaller with scant cytoplasm and high N:C ratio, lacking the abundant grey-blue cytoplasm and folded nuclei.

ddx.dx: Large cell lymphoma in leukemic phase
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm and coarser chromatin and express B/T-cell markers rather than CD14/CD64/lysozyme.

61369.recognize_zh: 血片中兩顆雙葉核嗜酸性球，細胞質中橘紅色顆粒分佈不均、部分區域顆粒稀少而呈淡藍色（部分去顆粒化），外觀大致成熟；形態本身無法判定是否為克隆性，須以 FIP1L1::PDGFRA 等檢查確認。
features: Two mature-sized eosinophils with bilobed nuclei and condensed chromatin
Orange-red eosinophilic granules unevenly distributed in the cytoplasm
Areas of cytoplasmic hypogranularity with pale blue-gray clearing (partial degranulation)
No immature eosinophils or blasts in the field
Background erythrocytes unremarkable
61369.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows eosinophils with bilobed nuclei and cytoplasm containing orange-red granules that are unevenly distributed with areas of hypogranularity and cytoplasmic clearing. No blasts or immature eosinophils are seen in this field. Eosinophil morphology is largely mature and does not reliably separate reactive from clonal eosinophilia; in the setting of persistent eosinophilia, evaluation for FIP1L1::PDGFRA (e.g., CHIC2 deletion FISH or RT-PCR), elevated serum tryptase and marrow examination is recommended to establish a myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with PDGFRA rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Reactive eosinophilia (parasitic infection, allergy, drug reaction)
ddx.vs: Eosinophils may appear similarly degranulated, so exclusion requires clinical evaluation and absence of a clonal rearrangement.
Diagnosed only after molecular testing excludes PDGFRA, PDGFRB, FGFR1, JAK2 and other rearrangements and no clonality is found.
Requires clonal genetic abnormality or increased blasts without the defining tyrosine kinase fusions.
Driven by an aberrant cytokine-producing T-cell population (e.g., CD3-/CD4+) detected by flow cytometry rather than a PDGFRA fusion.

61241.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中白血球幾乎全是形態一致的芽細胞，核質比高、染色質細緻，其中數顆核中央有淡染圓形區（杯狀核凹陷），加上紅血球背景與極少成熟白血球，符合高芽細胞比例的 AML。
features: Marked increase in circulating blasts; virtually all nucleated cells in the field are blasts
Blasts are medium-sized (about 1.5x a red cell) with high N:C ratio and scant basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Round nuclei with fine chromatin; several show a central pale round nuclear invagination (cup-like)
No mature neutrophils visible; Auer rods not evident at this magnification
A smudged/disrupted cell and normocytic red cells with occasional teardrop-shaped forms in the background
61241.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a marked leukocytosis composed almost entirely of monotonous medium-sized blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm. Several blasts contain a pale, round central nuclear invagination giving a cup-like appearance. Mature granulocytes are not seen in this field and platelets appear decreased; a smudge cell is present. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with cup-like blasts, a morphology associated with NPM1 mutation and FLT3-ITD, correlating with the reported CD34-negative immunophenotype and normal karyotype.

ddx.vs: Blasts have bilobed 'butterfly' nuclei, often Auer rod bundles and a DIC picture, and are confirmed by PML::RARA rather than NPM1.
Lymphoblasts lack cup-like invaginations and are MPO negative with TdT and B/T-lineage markers.

ddx.dx: Monocytic AML (e.g., AML with KMT2A rearrangement)
ddx.vs: Monoblasts/promonocytes have abundant gray-blue cytoplasm, folded nuclei and are NSE/CD14/CD64 positive rather than showing central cup-like clefts.

61177.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片中腫瘤細胞大而呈多角形，細胞質豐富嗜酸性，細胞核偏位、呈泡狀並有單一大核仁，形似神經節細胞（ganglion cell），背景是淡粉紅色纖維狀神經氈，符合具神經節分化的神經母細胞瘤。
features: Large polygonal tumor cells with abundant eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm
Eccentric round vesicular nuclei with a single large, prominent nucleolus (ganglion-like cells)
Occasional binucleate cells and nuclear pleomorphism
Pale fibrillary neuropil-like background between tumor cells
Admixed smaller neuroblasts with hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Residual thin-walled vessels with red cells; normal hematopoiesis absent in field
61177.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy at high power shows replacement of the marrow by a tumor composed predominantly of large polygonal cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and eccentric vesicular nuclei bearing single prominent nucleoli, resembling ganglion cells. Occasional binucleate forms and smaller hyperchromatic neuroblastic cells are admixed, set in a pale fibrillary neuropil-like background. No normal hematopoietic elements are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma showing ganglionic (differentiating) features.

ddx.vs: Rhabdomyoblasts have dense eosinophilic cytoplasm, sometimes strap-like with cross-striations, without neuropil, and are desmin/myogenin positive.
Megakaryocytes have multilobated nuclei without a single large nucleolus and lack fibrillary neuropil, staining with CD61.
Melanoma and carcinoma cells may have macronucleoli but lack neuropil and are SOX10/S100 or cytokeratin positive respectively.
Reed-Sternberg cells have inclusion-like nucleoli but sit in a mixed inflammatory and fibrotic background and are CD30/CD15 positive.

61113.recognize_zh: p53 免疫染色中，大量造血細胞核呈中至強陽性，包括成群的小型圓核細胞（紅血球前驅細胞）與巨核細胞，並散在數顆極強陽性的細胞核；正常骨髓 p53 陽性細胞應 <1%，這種廣泛強陽性提示 TP53 異常的治療相關骨髓腫瘤。
features: Numerous hematopoietic nuclei with moderate to strong nuclear p53 staining, far exceeding the <1% expected in normal marrow
Clusters of small round positive nuclei in an erythroid-island distribution
Positive megakaryocytes with nuclear (and some cytoplasmic blush) staining
Scattered cells with very strong (2+/3+) nuclear staining
Intervening negative cells and adipocytes provide internal contrast
61113.describe_en: p53 immunohistochemistry on a bone marrow core biopsy shows numerous hematopoietic cells with moderate to strong nuclear staining, including clustered erythroid precursors and megakaryocytes, with scattered cells showing very strong staining. This staining extent is markedly increased compared with the rare weakly positive cells expected in normal marrow. Strong nuclear p53 expression in a substantial proportion of cells correlates with TP53 mutation. In the clinical setting of prior therapy with morphologic dysplasia, the findings support a therapy-related myeloid neoplasm; TP53 sequencing is recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Wild-type pattern shows only weak, heterogeneous staining in scattered cells rather than strong nuclear staining in clusters of erythroid precursors and megakaryocytes.
PEL shows sheets of pronormoblasts (>80% erythroid, >30% pronormoblasts) that are frequently p53 strongly positive, whereas here positive cells are admixed with maturing hematopoiesis.
Truncating mutations yield complete absence of staining, so a negative p53 stain does not exclude TP53 alteration and NGS is needed.

61049.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片可見染色質疏鬆的巨母紅血球前驅細胞、核出芽／碎裂成多個小葉的紅血球母細胞（dyserythropoiesis），以及吞噬核碎屑的巨噬細胞（無效造血），右側有巨大後髓細胞，符合 B12 缺乏的巨母細胞變化。
features: Megaloblastic erythroid precursors with open, finely granular chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Erythroblast with multilobated/budding nucleus (nuclear fragmentation) indicating dyserythropoiesis
Macrophage containing multiple round purple nuclear debris fragments (ineffective erythropoiesis)
Giant metamyelocyte/band with large horseshoe-shaped nucleus at right edge
Background red cells with anisocytosis including macrocytes
61049.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows megaloblastic erythroid precursors with finely dispersed chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm. Dyserythropoiesis is evident, including an erythroblast with a multilobated, budding nucleus. A macrophage contains phagocytosed nuclear debris, reflecting intramedullary cell death, and a giant granulocytic precursor is seen at the edge. Background red cells show anisocytosis with macrocytes. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic anemia with dyserythropoiesis, as in vitamin B12 deficiency.

ddx.vs: MDS dyserythropoiesis is accompanied by ring sideroblasts, hypolobated megakaryocytes or pseudo-Pelger neutrophils rather than giant metamyelocytes, and vitamin levels are normal.
CDA shows binucleated/multinucleated late erythroblasts and internuclear bridges in younger patients, without giant granulocytic precursors.
Leukemia shows sheets of pronormoblasts with a maturation arrest rather than megaloblastic maturation.

60985.recognize_zh: 臨床照片中臉頰、耳朵、頸肩與前胸有多發、大小不一的紫紅色至暗紫色隆起結節與腫塊，外觀像瘀青的「挫傷樣」皮膚腫瘤，是母細胞性漿細胞樣樹突細胞腫瘤（BPDCN）的典型皮膚表現。
features: Multiple violaceous to dark purple, dome-shaped nodules and exophytic tumors
Large bilateral facial masses over the cheeks and preauricular/ear region
Smaller bruise-like plaques and nodules with erythematous-yellowish halos on shoulders and anterior chest
Focal surface crusting on the largest facial tumor without extensive ulceration
Clinical photograph only; histology and immunophenotype are required for diagnosis
60985.describe_en: Clinical photograph shows multiple violaceous, bruise-like nodules and large exophytic tumors involving both cheeks, the ear region, shoulders and anterior chest, with surrounding ecchymotic-appearing halos. The larger facial lesions show focal surface crusting. This pattern of widespread purple cutaneous nodules and tumors is highly suggestive of blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm, which must be confirmed on skin biopsy with CD4, CD56, CD123, TCF4 and TCL1 immunostains.

ddx.dx: Leukemia cutis / myeloid sarcoma (especially monocytic AML)
ddx.vs: Clinically similar; biopsy shows MPO- or lysozyme/CD14-positive myeloid cells rather than CD123/TCF4/TCL1-positive, MPO-negative blasts.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, leg type
ddx.vs: Red-violaceous tumors (usually on the leg) composed of CD20/BCL2/MUM1-positive B cells, not CD4/CD56/CD123-positive cells.

ddx.dx: Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma or cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: NK/T lymphoma shows angiodestruction with EBER positivity and cytotoxic markers, and lacks CD123/TCF4.
Violaceous plaques/nodules composed of HHV-8-positive spindle cells forming slit-like vascular spaces rather than sheets of blastoid cells.

60921.recognize_zh: 血片同時出現大紅血球與大橢圓形紅血球、明顯的裂片細胞與不規則碎片，以及過度分葉的嗜中性球，即「巨母細胞性變化合併微血管病變樣溶血」的組合，提示鈷胺素（維生素 B12）代謝異常，例如 cobalamin C 缺陷。
features: Marked anisopoikilocytosis with macrocytes and macro-ovalocytes
Numerous schistocytes, helmet cells and irregular fragmented red cells
Occasional target cells and teardrop-like forms
Hypersegmented neutrophil (≥6 lobes) in panel A
Circulating small dark round nucleated cell (probable nucleated red cell) in panel B; platelets present
60921.describe_en: Peripheral blood smears show marked anisopoikilocytosis with macrocytes and macro-ovalocytes admixed with numerous schistocytes, helmet cells and irregular red cell fragments, as well as occasional target and teardrop forms. A hypersegmented neutrophil and a small nucleated cell, probably a nucleated red cell, are present. Platelets are identified but not increased. The combination of megaloblastic features with fragmentation hemolysis is characteristic of disorders of cobalamin metabolism (e.g., cblC defect), which may present as a thrombotic microangiopathy; plasma homocysteine and methylmalonic acid levels are indicated.

ddx.vs: TTP shows schistocytes with severe thrombocytopenia and low ADAMTS13 but lacks macro-ovalocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils.

ddx.dx: Nutritional vitamin B12 or folate deficiency (pseudo-TMA)
ddx.vs: Morphology can be identical, so serum B12/folate levels and genetic testing for intracellular cobalamin defects are required to separate them.
HUS shows schistocytes with thrombocytopenia and renal failure but normocytic red cells without megaloblastic neutrophil changes.
MDS may show macrocytosis and pseudo-Pelger or hypogranular neutrophils rather than hypersegmentation, without marked schistocytosis.

60857.recognize_zh: 低倍皮膚切片中真皮淺層至深層有結節狀與片狀、密集的藍色淋巴細胞浸潤，沿膠原束間及附屬器周圍擴散，表皮下保留一層無浸潤的 grenz zone，此分布模式提示皮膚邊緣區淋巴瘤。
features: Dense nodular and diffuse lymphoid infiltrate involving superficial and deep dermis, extending to the lower edge of the biopsy
Infiltrate dissects between collagen bundles and surrounds adnexal structures
Some nodules with paler centers suggestive of residual/colonized follicles
Uninvolved grenz zone beneath an unremarkable epidermis; no epidermotropism
Bottom-heavy/deep extension of the infiltrate
60857.describe_en: Skin biopsy at low power shows a dense, patchy nodular to diffuse lymphoid infiltrate occupying the superficial and deep dermis and extending to the deep margin. The infiltrate percolates between collagen bundles and around adnexal structures, with some nodules showing paler centers suggestive of follicular structures. The epidermis is spared and separated from the infiltrate by a grenz zone, without epidermotropism. Findings are suggestive of a cutaneous B-cell lymphoproliferative process such as primary cutaneous marginal zone lymphoma; immunohistochemistry and light-chain studies are needed.

ddx.vs: Reactive infiltrates are usually top-heavy with well-formed polarized germinal centers, a mixed cell population and polytypic plasma cells.
PCFCL is composed of centrocytes and centroblasts with BCL6 positivity (and CD10 in follicular areas), usually on the head or trunk, rather than marginal zone cells with monotypic plasma cells.
MF shows a band-like superficial infiltrate of atypical T cells with epidermotropism and Pautrier microabscesses, not a grenz zone with deep nodules.

ddx.dx: Secondary cutaneous involvement by systemic B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Morphology may overlap; clinical staging and specific markers (e.g. cyclin D1, CD5) are needed to exclude systemic disease.

60793.recognize_zh: 積液細胞塊或抹片中為大型、胞質嗜鹼性的非典型淋巴樣細胞（A）；雙重染色下多數腫瘤細胞核呈棕色（B、C），僅少數細胞呈紅色胞質染色，代表罕見角蛋白陽性，是原發性滲出性淋巴瘤被誤診為癌的陷阱。
features: Panel A: discohesive large atypical cells with round to irregular nuclei, visible nucleoli and moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Panel B: many cells with dark brown nuclear staining and a single cell with red (fast red) cytoplasmic staining
Panel C: higher power showing a small group of brown-nuclear cells with red cytoplasmic reactivity in an adjacent cell
Only rare tumor cells show the red cytoplasmic signal; no cohesive epithelial clusters are seen
60793.describe_en: Effusion cytology (A) shows sheets of discohesive large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular nuclei, nucleoli and basophilic cytoplasm. A double immunostain (B, C) shows nuclear brown reactivity in most tumor cells, presumably HHV-8 LANA, with only rare cells showing red cytoplasmic staining, presumably cytokeratin. The chromogens are not labeled in the figure, so marker assignment is inferred from the title. Findings are consistent with primary effusion lymphoma with rare aberrant cytokeratin immunoreactivity, a pitfall for metastatic carcinoma.

ddx.vs: Tumor cells form cohesive three-dimensional groups with diffuse strong cytokeratin and are HHV-8 negative, rather than rare keratin+ cells among HHV-8+ discohesive cells.
Shows cohesive clusters with windows and diffuse keratin/calretinin/WT1 positivity, and lacks HHV-8.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with effusion
ddx.vs: Expresses CD20/PAX5 and is HHV-8 negative.

ddx.dx: Plasmablastic lymphoma or myeloma in effusion
ddx.vs: Share CD138/MUM1 plasmablastic phenotype but are HHV-8 negative.

60601.recognize_zh: 周邊血液與骨髓中的大型淋巴樣細胞核呈多葉、花瓣狀（flower cell）分葉，細胞質嗜鹼性；組織切片中也可見多葉核的大型細胞（箭頭）。花狀細胞常讓人聯想 ATLL，但在此為 DLBCL 白血病期，需靠 B 細胞免疫表型區分。
features: Large lymphoid cells with deeply clefted, multilobated 'flower-like' or cloverleaf nuclei
Relatively condensed to coarse chromatin and moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Cells about 2 times the size of red cells, with occasional small vacuoles
Tissue section: large atypical cells with multilobated nuclei (arrow) in a loose, edematous background
60601.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows large atypical lymphoid cells with deeply clefted, multilobated nuclei imparting a flower-like appearance and moderate amounts of basophilic cytoplasm; similar cells are present in the marrow aspirate. Tissue section shows large atypical cells with multilobated nuclei (arrow). Although the nuclear morphology resembles the flower cells of adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma, in the context of a B-cell immunophenotype and negative HTLV-1 serology, findings are consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma in leukemic phase with multilobated (flower cell) morphology.

ddx.vs: ATLL flower cells are CD4+/CD25+ T cells with HTLV-1 infection, whereas these cells express B-cell markers (CD19/CD20).
Sézary cells have cerebriform grooved nuclei and are CD4+ CD7- T cells with erythroderma, not multilobated large B cells.
Monoblasts/promonocytes have folded nuclei with fine chromatin, gray-blue cytoplasm and nonspecific esterase/CD14/CD64 positivity.

ddx.dx: Multilobated neutrophils or hypersegmented myeloid cells
ddx.vs: Neutrophils have pink specific granules and pale cytoplasm with thin chromatin bridges between lobes, unlike basophilic lymphoid cytoplasm.

60665.recognize_zh: 低倍（A）見周邊血小淋巴球明顯增多；高倍（B）的淋巴球核成熟、染色質塊狀，淡藍色胞質中可見細長平行的絲狀（filamentous-like）條紋包涵體，屬 CLL 細胞少見的胞質包涵體變異。
features: Absolute lymphocytosis of small mature-appearing lymphocytes at low power
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with coarse, clumped chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm containing fine, parallel filamentous or striated inclusions (panel B)
Cells with angular, irregular cytoplasmic outlines
Background red cells normochromic; smudge cells not prominent in these fields
60665.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a marked lymphocytosis composed of small, mature-appearing lymphocytes (panel A). At high power (panel B), the lymphocytes have round to slightly indented nuclei with coarse, clumped chromatin and a moderate rim of pale blue cytoplasm that contains fine, parallel, filament-like inclusions. No prominent nucleoli, azurophilic granules, or villous projections are seen. In the context of a CLL immunophenotype, findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with unusual filamentous cytoplasmic inclusions, which may represent immunoglobulin or crystalline material.

ddx.vs: Hairy cells have oval/bean-shaped nuclei with more open chromatin and circumferential hairy cytoplasmic projections, and are CD5 negative, CD103/CD11c/CD25/annexin A1 positive.
SMZL cells show polar villous projections rather than intracytoplasmic filaments and are usually CD5 and CD23 negative.
LPL shows plasmacytoid lymphocytes with basophilic cytoplasm and possible Dutcher/Russell bodies, with MYD88 L265P mutation, not CD5+/CD23+ CLL phenotype.
MCL cells often have irregular, notched nuclei with more dispersed chromatin and are cyclin D1/SOX11 positive and CD23 negative.

60729.recognize_zh: 服用奎寧類藥物 (chloroquine) 的病人周邊血中，白血球細胞質出現不尋常的顆粒：A 為帶空泡與細小紫紅色顆粒的單核樣細胞，B 為細胞質佈滿粗大深紫色顆粒的分葉核嗜中性球，需結合用藥史判讀。
features: Panel A: mononuclear cell with large kidney-shaped nucleus and moderately condensed chromatin
Panel A: pale grey-blue cytoplasm with multiple small clear vacuoles and scattered fine red-purple granules
Panel B: segmented neutrophil (three lobes joined by thin filaments)
Panel B: cytoplasm densely filled with coarse, dark purple granules, heavier than normal neutrophilic granulation
Background red cells normochromic without obvious inclusions
60729.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows leukocytes with abnormal cytoplasmic contents. One mononuclear (monocytoid) cell contains a folded nucleus and vacuolated cytoplasm with scattered fine azurophilic granules, and a segmented neutrophil shows coarse, dark, toxic-appearing cytoplasmic granulation. The red cells are unremarkable. In the clinical context of chloroquine therapy, these cytoplasmic changes are consistent with a drug-associated leukocyte granulation/vacuolation artifact; infection-related toxic change and inherited granulation anomalies should be excluded clinically.

ddx.vs: Toxic change is usually accompanied by Döhle bodies, left shift and clinical infection, whereas the drug effect occurs without sepsis and resolves on drug withdrawal.
Alder-Reilly granules are coarse and present in all granulocytes, lymphocytes and monocytes constitutively in mucopolysaccharidoses, not acquired in relation to a drug.
Chédiak-Higashi shows few giant fused granules rather than numerous uniform coarse granules.

60537.recognize_zh: 這是六格免疫組織化學（IHC）拼圖：上排「淋巴瘤區」可見大片瀰漫陽性的腫瘤性淋巴細胞，下排「鄰近腸病變區」小腸絨毛上皮內可見大量陽性的上皮內淋巴球（IEL）；本圖未標示各格抗體名稱，判讀需對照原始說明。
features: Composite of six immunohistochemical panels labeled 'lymphoma areas' (top row) and 'adjacent enteropathic areas' (bottom row); antibodies are not labeled
Top left: diffuse membranous positivity in a dense lymphoid infiltrate surrounding a negative central structure
Top middle: only scattered positive cells among negative larger tumor cells
Top right: strong membranous/cytoplasmic positivity in sheets of medium-to-large atypical cells
Bottom row: increased positive intraepithelial lymphocytes within villous and crypt epithelium and lamina propria, supporting an associated enteropathy
Brown DAB chromogen with hematoxylin counterstain
60537.describe_en: Composite immunohistochemical figure of small-intestinal tissue compares tumor areas with the adjacent mucosa. In the lymphoma areas, one marker stains a dense infiltrate diffusely, a second highlights only scattered cells with the tumor cells negative, and a third shows strong staining in sheets of medium-to-large atypical lymphoid cells. In the adjacent enteropathic mucosa, the same markers highlight markedly increased intraepithelial lymphocytes within surface and crypt epithelium. Because the antibodies are not labeled, the specific phenotype cannot be read from the image alone; in the context of the title, the pattern of a T-cell tumor with an adjacent intraepithelial lymphocytosis is consistent with enteropathy-associated T-cell lymphoma (classic EATL, formerly type I), typically CD3+, CD4-, CD8-, CD56-, often CD30+.

ddx.dx: Monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma (formerly EATL type II)
ddx.vs: MEITL consists of monomorphic small-to-medium cells that are CD8+, CD56+ and MATK+, without the pleomorphism, CD30 expression and celiac background typical of EATL.
RCD II shows aberrant intraepithelial lymphocytes (surface CD3-/CD8-) but no mass-forming transmural tumor.

ddx.dx: Intestinal ALK-negative anaplastic large cell lymphoma or PTCL, NOS
ddx.vs: These lack an associated enteropathy with increased intraepithelial lymphocytes in adjacent mucosa.

ddx.dx: Indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the GI tract
ddx.vs: It shows a superficial, non-destructive infiltrate of small mature T cells with a low Ki-67, not sheets of large atypical cells.

60473.recognize_zh: 高倍下幾乎全是大型細胞，核為圓形泡狀、染色質邊緣化，並有 1–3 個貼附核膜的核仁（中心母細胞 centroblasts），成片排列而無小型中心細胞混雜，是濾泡性淋巴瘤 3B 級的細胞組成。
features: Solid sheets of large cells, nuclei 2-3 times the size of a small lymphocyte
Round to oval vesicular nuclei with peripheral chromatin margination
One to three nucleoli often apposed to the nuclear membrane (centroblast morphology)
Scant amphophilic cytoplasm with retraction artifact
Absence of admixed small centrocytes; delicate eosinophilic collagen strands and scattered apoptotic bodies/mitoses
60473.describe_en: High-power view shows solid sheets of large lymphoid cells with round to oval vesicular nuclei, marginated chromatin and one to three nucleoli, many apposed to the nuclear membrane, and scant amphophilic cytoplasm. Small centrocytes are essentially absent, and scattered mitoses and apoptotic bodies are present between delicate collagen strands. The cells are consistent with centroblasts; within a follicular architecture (confirmed by an FDC meshwork), findings are consistent with follicular lymphoma, grade 3B.

ddx.vs: Cytology is identical, so separation depends on architecture: diffuse areas lacking a CD21/CD23 follicular dendritic meshwork are classified as DLBCL.
Grade 3A follicles contain more than 15 centroblasts/HPF but retain admixed centrocytes, unlike the pure centroblast sheets seen here.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized and monotonous with multiple small central nucleoli, squared-off cytoplasm and a starry-sky pattern.
ALCL cells are more pleomorphic with abundant cytoplasm and hallmark cells and are CD30+/B-marker negative.

60153.recognize_zh: 紅血球大致正色素，可見數顆淚滴形紅血球（dacrocytes）；中央有一顆核圓而濃縮、細胞質灰色的小細胞，最符合有核紅血球（nucleated RBC），加上右下角含點彩的多色性紅血球，呈現骨髓纖維化的周邊血液線索。
features: Small cell with a round, condensed eccentric nucleus and grayish cytoplasm, most consistent with a late-stage nucleated red cell (small lymphocyte less likely)
Occasional dacrocytes and elongated red cells
Mild anisopoikilocytosis with normochromic red cells
Occasional polychromatophilic red cells, one with fine basophilic stippling (lower right)
Scattered normal-sized platelets
60153.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normochromic red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis, including occasional dacrocytes and polychromatophilic cells. A small cell with a condensed round nucleus and gray cytoplasm is present, most consistent with a circulating nucleated red cell, although a small lymphocyte cannot be entirely excluded at this resolution. Platelets are adequate. Findings are consistent with a leukoerythroblastic, myelofibrotic picture, compatible with post-polycythemic myelofibrosis in context.

ddx.vs: Peripheral blood features are identical, so a documented prior diagnosis of polycythemia vera is required for post-PV myelofibrosis.
Shows the same leukoerythroblastosis and teardrops but marrow biopsy reveals infiltrating tumor or granulomas.

ddx.dx: Hemolytic anemia with nucleated red cells
ddx.vs: Shows marked polychromasia with spherocytes or schistocytes rather than teardrop cells.

60089.recognize_zh: 整個視野幾乎都是大小一致的脂肪細胞，造血細胞只剩脂肪間狹窄的條索，細胞量明顯低於 10%，且看不到異常浸潤細胞；這是嚴重低細胞性骨髓（hypocellular marrow），在兒童須考慮先天性骨髓衰竭如 dyskeratosis congenita。
features: Markedly hypocellular marrow (<10% cellularity) replaced by mature adipocytes
Residual hematopoietic tissue confined to thin interstitial strands between fat cells
Residual cells are predominantly small round mononuclear cells (lymphocytes/erythroid precursors) with extravasated red cells
No megakaryocytes identified in this field; granulopoiesis inconspicuous
No fibrosis, granulomas, or infiltrating atypical/blast population
60089.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy sections show a markedly hypocellular marrow with cellularity well below 10%, the marrow space being occupied almost entirely by mature adipose tissue. Residual hematopoietic elements are present only as thin interstitial strands and consist mainly of small mononuclear cells with interstitial hemorrhage; megakaryocytes are not identified in this field and trilineage hematopoiesis is markedly reduced. There is no fibrosis, granulomatous inflammation, or infiltrate of atypical cells or blasts. Findings are consistent with severe marrow aplasia; in the appropriate clinical setting (mucocutaneous triad, short telomeres) this supports an inherited bone marrow failure syndrome such as dyskeratosis congenita.

ddx.vs: Morphologically identical fatty marrow; distinguished by clinical features, telomere length testing, and germline genetics (TERT, TERC, DKC1) rather than histology.
Shows dysplastic megakaryocytes, clustered CD34+ blasts, or clonal cytogenetic abnormalities, which are absent in this bland aplastic marrow.
Also an inherited aplastic marrow; separated by chromosome breakage testing with DEB/MMC rather than morphology.

ddx.dx: Hypocellular AML or hairy cell leukemia
ddx.vs: Would show an infiltrate of blasts or hairy cells (with reticulin fibrosis in HCL) within the residual cellular areas, not seen here.

30265.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血抹片中散布大量芽細胞（高核質比、深藍細胞質，部分有泡狀突起），另有有核紅血球與少數嗜中性球，顯示明顯的周邊血芽細胞增多；在唐氏症新生兒符合暫時性異常骨髓增生（TAM）。
features: Numerous circulating blasts with high N:C ratio, round nuclei and scant basophilic cytoplasm, some with cytoplasmic blebs
Blasts markedly outnumber mature neutrophils in this field
Occasional nucleated red cells
Large platelets and platelet fragments present
Red cell anisopoikilocytosis with scattered fragmented and teardrop forms
30265.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (Wright-Giemsa, low power) shows marked leukocytosis composed predominantly of blasts with high N:C ratio and scant basophilic cytoplasm, several with cytoplasmic blebs, accompanied by occasional nucleated red cells and only a few mature neutrophils. Large platelets are present and red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis. Detailed nuclear features are limited at this magnification. In a neonate with Down syndrome, findings are consistent with transient abnormal myelopoiesis, in which peripheral blast counts frequently exceed marrow blast counts.

ddx.dx: Myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome
ddx.vs: ML-DS usually presents after the neonatal period with persistent cytopenias, marrow fibrosis and additional mutations rather than a spontaneously regressing neonatal blastosis.
It occurs without trisomy 21, often with monocytic or lymphoid blasts and leukemia cutis, and does not resolve spontaneously.
Leukemoid reactions show neutrophilia with left shift and toxic changes rather than a predominance of blasts.
Infection yields nucleated red cells and reactive lymphocytes but not a monotonous blast population with megakaryoblastic immunophenotype.

18489.recognize_zh: 這是低腫瘤負荷濾泡性淋巴瘤（LTB-FL）的處置流程圖（非形態學影像）：依年齡 70 歲分流，兩組皆可選擇觀察等待（W&W）或考慮 rituximab；年輕者在出現高腫瘤負荷（HTB）時開始 R-化療，年長者若進展則在達高腫瘤負荷前先給 rituximab。
features: Decision tree starting from low-tumor-burden follicular lymphoma (LTB FL)
First branch by age: younger than 70 versus 70 or older
Age younger than 70: watch and wait or consider rituximab; initiate R-chemotherapy upon development of high tumor burden
Age 70 or older: watch and wait or consider rituximab
Age 70 or older on watch and wait: continue if no progression; if progression, initiate rituximab before high tumor burden develops
18489.describe_en: This non-morphologic figure is a suggested management algorithm for low-tumor-burden follicular lymphoma. Patients are first divided by age (younger than 70 versus 70 or older), and in both groups watch and wait or single-agent rituximab are acceptable initial options. Younger patients under observation start rituximab-chemotherapy when high tumor burden develops, whereas older patients under observation continue watch and wait if there is no progression but receive rituximab at progression before high tumor burden is reached, avoiding chemotherapy toxicity. The algorithm reflects the lack of survival benefit from early treatment in asymptomatic disease.

13497.recognize_zh: 高倍下一群大型原始細胞，核圓、染色質細緻，胞質深藍且邊緣常有一整圈清楚的小圓形空泡（punched-out vacuoles），核上也可見少數空泡；這種以空泡化原始紅血球為主的表現，符合純紅血球白血病。
features: Large immature cells with round, central to eccentric nuclei and moderate N:C ratio
Finely granular chromatin with indistinct nucleoli
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a rim of discrete, sharply punched-out vacuoles, some coalescing and some overlying the nucleus
No cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods
Occasional smaller erythroblast with condensed chromatin; red cells in background
13497.describe_en: High-power bone marrow aspirate smear shows sheets of large immature cells with round nuclei, finely granular chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing many discrete, punched-out vacuoles arranged predominantly at the cell periphery. No granules or Auer rods are seen. Scattered smaller erythroblasts with condensed chromatin are present. Findings are consistent with acute erythroid leukemia (pure erythroid leukemia) with proerythroblast predominance; confirmation with E-cadherin, CD71 and glycophorin A immunophenotyping, PAS (block positivity) and TP53 analysis is recommended.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells have similar vacuolated basophilic cytoplasm but are mature B cells (CD19, CD10, surface light chain) with MYC rearrangement.
Megakaryoblasts show cytoplasmic blebs rather than punched-out vacuoles and express CD41/CD61.
Monoblasts have more abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and nonspecific esterase positivity, and are E-cadherin negative.

12537.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片抗酸染色（Ziehl-Neelsen）在藍色背景下可見大量洋紅色細長桿菌，散在於間質並聚集在組織球內，在 HIV 病人強烈提示非結核分枝桿菌（Mycobacterium avium complex）感染。
features: Numerous slender, beaded magenta (acid-fast) bacilli scattered throughout the marrow stroma
Clusters of bacilli packed within histiocyte cytoplasm, forming dense red aggregates
Methylene blue counterstained cellular marrow with spindled histiocytes and mixed hematopoietic cells
Adjacent fat spaces; no well-formed caseating granuloma is evident in this field
A megakaryocyte-like large cell is visible at the lower edge
12537.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy stained with Ziehl-Neelsen shows a cellular marrow infiltrated by sheets of histiocytes. Innumerable slender, beaded acid-fast bacilli are present, both free in the interstitium and packed within histiocyte cytoplasm. Well-formed granulomas are not evident in this field, in keeping with a poor granulomatous response in advanced immunosuppression. In an HIV-positive patient with a very low CD4 count, findings are consistent with disseminated Mycobacterium avium-intracellulare complex infection; culture or PCR is required for speciation.

ddx.vs: M. tuberculosis usually shows well-formed, often caseating granulomas with few bacilli, whereas MAC in AIDS shows sheets of foamy histiocytes with enormous bacillary loads; speciation requires culture or PCR.
Lepra bacilli form globi and are Fite-positive but weakly acid-fast with standard ZN, and marrow involvement in this clinical setting is exceptional.
Nocardia forms branching filaments that are only partially acid-fast on modified stains, unlike the short straight non-branching MAC rods.

11193.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中的異常細胞核呈雙葉、左右對稱的蝴蝶／滑板狀（bilobed, butterfly nucleus），胞質淡灰藍、顆粒極細幾乎看不到，血小板稀少，這是微顆粒型急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL, microgranular variant）的典型線索。
features: Abnormal promyelocyte with a bilobed, overlapping butterfly-shaped nucleus
Fine chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Moderate pale gray-blue cytoplasm with very fine, barely visible granules (hypogranular)
Second cell with a round to subtly folded nucleus and finely granular violet cytoplasm
No Auer rod bundles visible; platelets very sparse in this field
11193.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered abnormal leukocytes, including a cell with a characteristic bilobed butterfly-shaped nucleus and pale gray-blue cytoplasm containing only very fine granules, and another cell with a round to slightly folded nucleus and finely granular cytoplasm. Auer rods are not seen in this field and platelets appear markedly decreased. Red cells are normocytic. Findings are suggestive of the microgranular (hypogranular) variant of acute promyelocytic leukemia; urgent coagulation studies and PML-RARA testing are recommended.

ddx.vs: Monocytic cells have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin and vacuolated cytoplasm and are NSE-positive, whereas microgranular APL cells are strongly MPO-positive, CD34/HLA-DR negative and PML-RARA positive.
Classic APL has cytoplasm filled with coarse azurophilic granules and faggot cells, while the microgranular variant appears nearly agranular by light microscopy and usually has higher WBC counts.
NPM1-mutated blasts can have cup-like nuclei and be HLA-DR/CD34 negative, but lack butterfly nuclei, DIC and PML-RARA fusion.

6521.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一群黏聚的大細胞，核偏位、細胞質淡藍含空泡，部分細胞拉出單極細胞質尾巴（蝌蚪狀 tadpole / strap-like），這種偏位核加細胞質尾巴的形態提示橫紋肌母細胞分化，符合轉移性胚胎型橫紋肌肉瘤。
features: Cohesive cluster of large cells with round, eccentrically placed nuclei
Moderate N:C ratio; finely granular chromatin with small nucleoli
Pale to moderately basophilic cytoplasm with small clear vacuoles and a few larger vacuoles
Several cells with a unipolar tapering cytoplasmic tail (tadpole or strap-like shape), suggestive of rhabdomyoblastic differentiation
Adjacent normal marrow elements (segmented neutrophil, band) for size comparison, showing the tumor cells are much larger
6521.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive aggregate of large atypical cells among red cells and scattered normal granulocytes. The cells have eccentric round nuclei with finely granular chromatin and small nucleoli, and pale basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm; several cells extend unipolar cytoplasmic tails, imparting a tadpole-like shape. The clustering and cytoplasmic tails are not features of hematopoietic blasts. Findings are consistent with metastatic rhabdomyosarcoma (embryonal type per history); confirmation by desmin and myogenin immunostaining is recommended.

ddx.vs: Megakaryoblasts may clump and show cytoplasmic blebs, but they have budding platelet-like projections rather than long unipolar tails and are CD41/CD61 positive, desmin/myogenin negative.
Neuroblastoma cells have scant cytoplasm and form rosettes with neuropil, without eccentric nuclei and tapering cytoplasmic tails.
Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei but show clock-face chromatin, a perinuclear hof and deeply basophilic cytoplasm, and do not form cohesive clusters with tails.
Carcinoma clusters are also cohesive but usually show greater pleomorphism, epithelial-type sheets or glands, and keratin rather than desmin/myogenin expression.

3641.recognize_zh: 高度細胞化的骨髓抹片中同一視野就有四顆大型巨核細胞，其中幾顆核呈圓形或少分葉、胞質較嗜鹼性（較年輕的巨核細胞），背景紅血球與顆粒球前驅細胞活躍，符合化療後恢復期的巨核細胞增生（megakaryocytic hyperplasia）。
features: Markedly hypercellular aspirate with four megakaryocytes in a single high-power field
Megakaryocytes vary in maturity: one large with a multilobated nucleus and granular cytoplasm, others with round to minimally lobated nuclei and more basophilic cytoplasm (young forms)
Active erythropoiesis with numerous polychromatophilic and orthochromatic erythroblasts
Maturing granulocytic precursors and scattered lymphocytes; no blast excess evident
3641.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is markedly hypercellular with increased megakaryocytes, including a mature form with a lobulated nucleus and several younger forms with round to minimally lobated nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm. Erythroid precursors are abundant and show orderly maturation, and granulocytic precursors mature through to segmented forms without an evident increase in blasts. The younger megakaryocytes are large rather than micromegakaryocytes. In a patient recovering from chemotherapy, findings are consistent with regenerative megakaryocytic (and erythroid) hyperplasia.

ddx.vs: MDS megakaryocytes are small or micromegakaryocytes with hypolobated or widely separated round lobes, usually with dysplasia in other lineages and in the absence of recent chemotherapy.
AMKL shows increased megakaryoblasts (at least 20% blasts) with high N:C ratio and cytoplasmic blebs rather than maturing megakaryocytes.
MPN megakaryocytes are large and hyperlobated with clustering in biopsy, persisting with thrombocytosis and driver mutations rather than transient post-chemotherapy recovery.
ITP also shows increased megakaryocytes but in the setting of isolated peripheral thrombocytopenia rather than panmyeloid regeneration after therapy.

2361.recognize_zh: 一顆巨大、細胞質淡粉紅的組織球內含數十顆完整的淋巴球與漿細胞，各自被透明暈圈包圍，這就是 Rosai-Dorfman 病典型的細胞穿入現象（emperipolesis）。
features: Very large histiocyte with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Numerous intact lymphocytes and plasma cells within the cytoplasm, many surrounded by clear halos (emperipolesis)
Histiocyte nucleus round and vesicular with a distinct nucleolus
Adjacent histiocytes with abundant pale cytoplasm, one containing a clear vacuolated space
Background small lymphocytes and plasma cells
2361.describe_en: Lymph node section (H&E) at high power shows large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and round vesicular nuclei with small nucleoli. One histiocyte contains numerous intact, viable-appearing lymphocytes and plasma cells within clear cytoplasmic spaces (emperipolesis). The background contains small lymphocytes and plasma cells without cytologic atypia. Findings are consistent with Rosai-Dorfman disease (sinus histiocytosis with massive lymphadenopathy); S100 and CD68 positivity with CD1a negativity would confirm.

ddx.vs: LCH cells have grooved, coffee-bean nuclei with eosinophils and are CD1a/langerin positive, lacking prominent emperipolesis.
In hemophagocytosis the engulfed cells (often erythrocytes) are degraded inside phagolysosomes, whereas emperipolesis shows intact lymphocytes in clear vacuoles.
Ordinary sinus histiocytes are smaller, S100 negative and lack conspicuous emperipolesis.

ddx.dx: Metastatic melanoma or carcinoma in sinuses
ddx.vs: Tumor cells show nuclear atypia and lineage markers (e.g., SOX10/HMB45, keratin) without emperipolesis.

1401.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中正常造血幾乎被取代，可見大量卵圓形核、染色質細緻、有小核仁的未成熟細胞散佈於粉紅色纖維化間質中，並夾雜深染小型核，符合伴隨骨髓纖維化的急性巨核母細胞白血病。
features: Hypercellular marrow replaced by medium to large immature cells with oval nuclei
Fine, open chromatin with small but distinct nucleoli
Moderate amphophilic cytoplasm with indistinct borders
Streaming arrangement within a pink fibrillary (fibrotic) stroma
Scattered small hyperchromatic, irregular nuclei possibly representing dysplastic megakaryocytic forms
Normal trilineage hematopoiesis largely absent; few fat spaces
1401.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) shows marked replacement of normal hematopoiesis by a population of medium to large immature cells with oval nuclei, fine chromatin and small nucleoli, arranged in a streaming pattern within a fibrillary, fibrotic-appearing stroma. Scattered small hyperchromatic irregular nuclei are present, and normal trilineage maturation is not evident. The fibrotic background explains the frequent dry tap. Findings are suggestive of acute megakaryoblastic leukemia; reticulin staining and immunohistochemistry for CD61/CD42b and CD34 are needed for confirmation.

ddx.vs: PMF shows clusters of large atypical mature megakaryocytes rather than sheets of immature blasts.
APMF has a trilineage proliferation with blasts not predominantly megakaryoblastic, requiring immunohistochemical lineage assessment.
Metastatic carcinoma or sarcoma is keratin or lineage-marker positive and negative for CD61/CD42b.
Has fewer than 20% blasts with dysplastic micromegakaryocytes; blast quantification by CD34 separates it.

1913.recognize_zh: 中央一顆大型細胞，細胞核圓形偏小、染色質細緻，細胞質豐富、邊界不規則，內含吞噬的紅血球碎片、空泡與藍綠色顆粒狀含鐵血黃素（hemosiderin），這些吞噬物讓你認出它是組織球（巨噬細胞）。
features: Large cell with abundant, grey-purple cytoplasm and irregular, frayed cell borders
Single round nucleus, small relative to cell size, with fine to reticular chromatin
Cytoplasmic phagocytosed material including red cell fragments, vacuoles, and dark granules
Blue-green refractile pigment consistent with hemosiderin
Background of red cells without other nucleated cells in the field
1913.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large macrophage with a low N:C ratio, a single round nucleus with fine chromatin, and abundant cytoplasm with irregular borders. The cytoplasm contains phagocytosed red cell fragments, vacuoles, dark granular debris, and blue-green hemosiderin-like pigment. No intracellular microorganisms are identified at this resolution. Findings are consistent with a reactive histiocyte with phagocytic and iron-laden cytoplasmic contents.

ddx.vs: Hemophagocytosis requires intact engulfed erythrocytes, platelets, or nucleated cells, plus clinical HLH criteria, whereas this cell shows mainly fragmented debris and pigment.
Megakaryocytes have a large lobulated nucleus and pink granular cytoplasm without phagocytosed material.
Osteoclasts are multinucleated with many separate, similar nuclei rather than a single nucleus.
Organisms appear as uniform small yeasts with halos or amastigotes with a kinetoplast, which are not identified here.

2425.recognize_zh: 淋巴結切片呈多形性浸潤：小淋巴球、帶淡染泡狀核的大型活化細胞（immunoblasts）與組織球混雜，少數細胞核呈毛玻璃狀或核內似有包涵體；本圖解析度不足以明確辨認病毒包涵體，需搭配 VZV 免疫染色。
features: Polymorphous infiltrate effacing a portion of the node at medium power
Many medium to large activated lymphoid cells (immunoblasts) with vesicular nuclei and small nucleoli
Admixed small mature lymphocytes and epithelioid histiocytes with pale cytoplasm
Occasional cells with cleared, glassy nuclei or possible intranuclear inclusions, not definitive at this resolution
Scattered eosinophilic red cells; no sheets of monomorphic atypical cells
2425.describe_en: Lymph node section shows a polymorphous infiltrate composed of small lymphocytes, numerous medium to large activated lymphoid cells with vesicular nuclei and small nucleoli, and admixed epithelioid histiocytes. A few cells have cleared, glassy-appearing nuclei suggestive of possible viral cytopathic change, although definite Cowdry A inclusions or multinucleation cannot be confirmed at this resolution. There are no monotonous sheets of atypical cells. The appearance is that of an atypical reactive immunoblastic lymphadenitis compatible with herpes zoster lymphadenitis in the right clinical setting; VZV immunohistochemistry or PCR is needed for confirmation.

ddx.vs: DLBCL shows sheets of monomorphic large atypical B-cells with architectural effacement and light chain restriction, whereas this infiltrate is polymorphous with a spectrum of cell sizes.
Hodgkin lymphoma contains Reed-Sternberg cells that are CD30+/CD15+/PAX5-weak, whereas reactive immunoblasts in viral lymphadenitis are CD30 variable but CD15 negative with strong PAX5 or CD3.
EBV lymphadenitis shows a similar immunoblastic proliferation but is EBER positive and lacks herpesvirus intranuclear inclusions.
HSV and VZV inclusions look identical; distinction requires HSV versus VZV immunostains or PCR.

1273.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中成群的母細胞，核圓、染色質細緻、有 1–2 個明顯核仁，細胞質中等量淡藍色且幾乎無顆粒，視野中幾乎看不到分化中的前骨髓球或骨髓球，符合 AML without maturation。
features: Clusters of large blasts with high N:C ratio
Round to slightly indented nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin
One to two prominent nucleoli in many blasts
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm, largely agranular; no Auer rods seen
Minimal maturing granulocytes; one cell at upper left with coarse chromatin and a mitotic figure at lower center
1273.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows clusters of large blasts with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, round to slightly indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and one to two prominent nucleoli. The cytoplasm is moderate, pale blue and largely agranular, and no Auer rods are identified in this field. Maturing granulocytic elements are scarce, and a mitotic figure is present. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia without maturation, provided myeloid lineage is confirmed (MPO or flow cytometry) and maturing granulocytes are less than 10% of nonerythroid cells.

ddx.vs: ALL blasts often have scant cytoplasm and are MPO negative with TdT/CD19 or CD3 expression, so cytochemistry or flow cytometry is required to exclude it.
AML with minimal differentiation is morphologically similar but has fewer than 3% MPO-positive blasts, with myeloid lineage shown only by flow cytometry.
AML with maturation shows at least 10% maturing granulocytes such as promyelocytes and myelocytes, which are nearly absent here.
Monoblasts have more abundant gray-blue cytoplasm, folded nuclei and are nonspecific esterase positive.

1209.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中細胞極多，以大小一致、核圓至卵圓、細胞質淡藍且邊界不清的單核細胞為主，彼此間距規則，取代正常多樣的造血細胞，符合毛細胞白血病的單一形態浸潤；此倍率下看不到毛狀突起。
features: Hypercellular aspirate at low power with a monotonous mononuclear cell population
Small-to-medium cells with round to oval nuclei and evenly dispersed chromatin
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm with indistinct borders giving evenly spaced nuclei
Marked reduction of granulocytic and erythroid maturation
Dark marrow particle and a megakaryocyte at lower left; numerous fat spaces
1209.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low magnification is hypercellular and dominated by a monotonous population of small to medium-sized mononuclear cells with round to oval nuclei and moderate pale cytoplasm with indistinct borders, producing evenly spaced nuclei. Normal granulocytic and erythroid maturation is markedly diminished; a marrow particle and a megakaryocyte are present at the lower left. Cytoplasmic hairy projections cannot be resolved at this magnification, so correlation with higher-power morphology, flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) and BRAF V600E is needed. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by hairy cell leukemia; note that many cases yield a dry tap, making an aspirate like this less typical.

ddx.vs: SMZL cells have more condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm and are CD103/CD25/annexin A1-negative.
CLL cells are small with coarse block-like chromatin and scant cytoplasm, and are CD5+/CD23+ rather than CD103+.
Blasts have finer chromatin, higher N:C ratio and visible nucleoli, and express CD34 or TdT rather than a mature B-cell phenotype.
Mast cells contain abundant metachromatic granules and express CD117 and tryptase.

1145.recognize_zh: 周邊血中可見數個單核球系細胞，核呈摺疊、分葉狀或腦迴樣，灰藍色細胞質有空泡與毛邊，另有一個核呈環狀的小型顆粒球，提示急性單核球性白血病中的異常單核球。
features: Monocytic cells with gray-blue cytoplasm and irregular, frayed cytoplasmic borders
Nuclei folded, lobulated or convoluted with delicate chromatin
Cytoplasmic vacuoles in several cells
Fine azurophilic granules in some monocytic cells
Small granulocyte with a ring-shaped nucleus
Background red cells with rouleaux-like stacking
1145.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several monocytic cells with gray-blue, variably vacuolated cytoplasm with frayed borders and folded, lobulated or convoluted nuclei with delicate chromatin. A small granulocyte with a ring-shaped nucleus is also present. Red cells show rouleaux-like stacking in this area. The monocytic cells show atypical nuclear configurations and immature chromatin. Findings are suggestive of abnormal monocytes/promonocytes in the setting of acute monocytic leukemia; flow cytometry and nonspecific esterase are recommended to enumerate blast equivalents.

ddx.vs: Reactive monocytes have mature condensed chromatin, lack nucleoli and do not form a population of atypical promonocytes.
CMML shows persistent monocytosis ≥0.5 x 10^9/L with <20% blasts plus promonocytes, whereas acute monocytic leukemia requires ≥20%.
Sézary cells have cerebriform nuclei with dense chromatin and scant nongranular cytoplasm, and are CD4+ T cells rather than CD14/CD64-positive monocytes.

1081.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片一群細胞中有數顆核偏位、細胞質淡藍的漿細胞，其中幾顆細胞質含粗大紅紫色嗜天青顆粒（Snapper-Schneid顆粒），同時可見較大、染色質較細的不成熟漿細胞。
features: Cluster of plasma cells, some large and immature with dispersed chromatin and abundant grey-blue cytoplasm
Several plasma cells with coarse reddish-purple azurophilic cytoplasmic granules
Eccentric nuclei with perinuclear hof in the more mature forms
Admixed band and segmented neutrophils and fat vacuoles
Scattered free granules in the background
1081.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of plasma cells ranging from mature forms with eccentric nuclei and perinuclear hofs to larger immature forms with dispersed chromatin and abundant grey-blue cytoplasm. Several plasma cells contain coarse reddish-purple azurophilic cytoplasmic granules consistent with Snapper-Schneid granules. Neutrophils and fat vacuoles are present in the background. Findings are compatible with a plasma cell neoplasm with azurophilic granulated plasma cells; quantitation and clonality studies are recommended.

ddx.vs: Promyelocytes lack a perinuclear hof with clock-face chromatin, show Golgi pallor with nucleoli, and are MPO positive/CD138 negative.
Eosinophil precursors contain larger orange-red refractile granules with some dark basophilic granules and have granulocytic nuclear features.
Mast cells have central round nuclei obscured by dense purple-black metachromatic granules and express tryptase and CD117.

4217.recognize_zh: 低倍皮膚切片可見真皮淺層血管周圍與附屬器周圍的淋巴球浸潤，並有細胞散入表皮；此倍率本身並不特異，需高倍與免疫染色及 HTLV-1 檢驗佐證 ATLL。
features: Superficial and mid-dermal perivascular lymphoid infiltrates in a patchy distribution
Denser band-like infiltrate along a follicular/adnexal structure on the right
Mild focal lymphocyte infiltration of the lower epidermis
Epidermis with compact orthokeratosis and no significant spongiosis
Individual cell cytology not assessable at this magnification
4217.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of skin shows patchy superficial and mid-dermal perivascular lymphoid infiltrates, with a denser infiltrate surrounding an adnexal structure and focal extension into the lower epidermis. The epidermis shows compact orthokeratosis without prominent spongiosis. Cytologic atypia cannot be assessed at this power. In conjunction with higher-power morphology, immunophenotype and HTLV-1 status, the findings are compatible with cutaneous involvement by adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma; the pattern alone is nonspecific.

ddx.vs: MF also shows superficial perivascular and epidermotropic T cells; distinction requires HTLV-1 serology and clinical/blood findings rather than low-power pattern.
Reactive dermatitis lacks cytologically atypical cells on high power and usually shows spongiosis or interface change with eosinophils.
T-PLL cutis produces perivascular/periadnexal infiltrates of small-medium TCL1+ cells without HTLV-1 association.

4089.recognize_zh: 組織中充滿大型、多形性的腫瘤細胞，核呈泡狀、核仁明顯，並可見怪異的大核與核分裂像，呈現間變性（anaplastic）外觀；需以 CD20/PAX5 與 CD30、ALK 免疫染色才能與 ALCL 區分。
features: Sheets of large pleomorphic cells, many 3-5 times a small lymphocyte
Vesicular nuclei with irregular contours and prominent nucleoli
Scattered bizarre, multilobated or giant nuclei
Moderate to abundant amphophilic cytoplasm with discohesive growth
Frequent mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies
4089.describe_en: Sections show a diffuse, discohesive proliferation of large pleomorphic cells with vesicular, irregular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm. Bizarre and multilobated nuclei are scattered, and mitotic figures and apoptotic debris are frequent. The appearance is that of an anaplastic large-cell neoplasm; with B-cell marker expression (CD20/PAX5) this is consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, anaplastic variant.

ddx.vs: ALCL shows hallmark cells with strong uniform CD30 and T-cell/cytotoxic markers but lacks CD20/PAX5, whereas anaplastic DLBCL is a B-cell lymphoma.
cHL has scattered Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in a reactive background, CD15+ with weak PAX5 and absent CD45/CD20, rather than sheets of B cells.
Non-hematolymphoid tumors are CD45-negative and express keratins or S100/SOX10.

4153.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結免疫染色中，濾泡間區呈棕色陽性、寬大的同心圓套區陰性，中央小型退化生發中心內只有零星陽性細胞並有血管穿入，呈 T 細胞標記的分布；可看出 Castleman 病的洋蔥皮套區與棒棒糖血管。標記未標示。
features: Positive interfollicular zones with a T-cell-type distribution
Broad negative mantle zones arranged concentrically around a small germinal center
Small regressed germinal center with scattered positive cells and a penetrating vessel
Multiple follicles with similar expanded negative mantles
Low-power pattern only; cytologic detail not assessable
4153.describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain (DAB; marker not specified, distribution typical of a T-cell marker such as CD3) on a lymph node shows positivity predominantly in the interfollicular zones, with only scattered positive cells within a small regressed germinal center. The surrounding broad, concentrically layered mantle zone is negative, and a vessel penetrates the germinal center. The preserved compartmentalization with expanded onion-skin mantles and an atretic, vascularized germinal center is consistent with hyaline-vascular Castleman disease.

ddx.vs: AITL shows expanded interfollicular atypical T cells co-expressing PD1/CXCL13/CD10 with extrafollicular CD21+ FDC meshworks.
Paracortical hyperplasia expands the T zone with immunoblasts but has normal follicles without onion-skin mantles or atretic germinal centers.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: Neoplastic mantles are cyclin D1/SOX11-positive and CD5-positive B cells rather than unstained polyclonal B cells.

4153.stain: IHC: marker not specified (T-cell pattern, likely CD3), DAB

3897.recognize_zh: 腹水細胞離心抹片中，大部分是胞質充滿空泡的巨噬細胞；細箭頭指的細胞胞質深藍、核偏一側且核旁有淡染區（hof），是漿細胞，在腹水中看到這種細胞應想到骨髓瘤侵犯。
features: Plasma cells (thin arrow) with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, eccentric round nucleus, clock-face chromatin and paranuclear hof
Several additional plasmacytoid cells with dense blue cytoplasm scattered in the field
Numerous large vacuolated macrophages with folded or reniform nuclei; thick arrow marks a macrophage with engulfed material
Occasional neutrophils and small lymphocytes; rare red cells
3897.describe_en: Cytospin of ascitic fluid shows a mixed population dominated by vacuolated macrophages with reniform nuclei, one containing phagocytosed material (thick arrow). Scattered among them are plasma cells with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, eccentric nuclei with coarse chromatin and paranuclear hofs (thin arrow). Occasional neutrophils and lymphocytes are present. In a patient with plasma cell myeloma, findings are suggestive of myelomatous involvement of the peritoneal fluid; clonality should be confirmed by kappa/lambda immunostaining or flow cytometry (CD138/CD38).

ddx.dx: Reactive polyclonal plasma cells in effusion
ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are fewer, cytologically mature and polytypic for kappa/lambda, whereas myeloma cells are monotypic and may be binucleate or show nucleoli.
Mesothelial cells have central nuclei, a two-tone cytoplasm with a peripheral brush border/'skirt' and often form clusters, and they are calretinin-positive rather than CD138/light chain-restricted.

ddx.dx: Plasmablastic lymphoma or primary effusion lymphoma
ddx.vs: These show larger immunoblastic cells with prominent nucleoli, lack a myeloma history and are often HHV-8 or EBV positive.

3961.recognize_zh: 雙箭頭指的是兩端尖細、呈新月形的鐮刀型紅血球（sickle cell），單箭頭指的紅血球裡有小而圓的深紫色 Howell-Jolly 小體，反映脾臟功能喪失，兩者合起來是鐮刀型貧血的典型抹片。
features: Elongated crescent-shaped sickle cells with pointed ends (double arrow)
Red cell containing small round dense purple Howell-Jolly bodies (arrow), indicating hyposplenism
Several elongated/oat-shaped red cells and mild anisocytosis
Numerous platelets in the background
3961.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows irreversibly sickled red cells with elongated crescent shapes and pointed ends (double arrow), accompanied by oat-shaped and elongated forms. A red cell contains small, round, dense Howell-Jolly bodies (arrow), consistent with functional asplenia. Platelets are plentiful. Findings are consistent with sickle cell disease (HbSS) with autosplenectomy; confirmation by hemoglobin electrophoresis or HPLC is recommended.

ddx.vs: HbSC shows many target cells and blunt-ended, straight-edged SC crystals, with classic thin sickle cells being uncommon.
Elliptocytes are oval to rod-shaped cells with blunt, rounded ends rather than pointed crescent tips.
Pappenheimer bodies are multiple fine peripheral granules that are iron-positive, whereas Howell-Jolly bodies are larger, round, dense DNA inclusions.

3833.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中，骨小樑之間有一大片境界不清、由梭形至類上皮組織球與淋巴球構成的淡粉紅病灶，取代正常造血組織，屬邊界不清的肉芽腫。
features: Large, ill-defined aggregate of spindled to epithelioid histiocytes replacing marrow between trabeculae
Admixed small lymphocytes within a pale eosinophilic, loosely fibrillar background
No well-formed giant cells or caseous necrosis identified at this magnification
Adjacent uninvolved marrow with megakaryocytes and trilineage hematopoiesis (upper right)
Lesion abuts bony trabeculae
3833.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows a large, poorly circumscribed aggregate of spindled to epithelioid histiocytes with admixed lymphocytes, replacing hematopoietic marrow between bony trabeculae. Multinucleated giant cells and caseous necrosis are not identified at this magnification. The adjacent marrow shows trilineage hematopoiesis with megakaryocytes. Findings are consistent with a poorly formed granuloma; in an HIV-positive patient, AFB and fungal stains with cultures are indicated to exclude mycobacterial (e.g., MAC) or fungal infection.

ddx.vs: Hodgkin involvement shows scattered large CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed, often fibrotic background.
Mast cell lesions are spindled and paratrabecular or perivascular but are CD117/tryptase positive with aberrant CD25.
Fibrosis contains streaming fibroblasts with atypical megakaryocytes and increased reticulin, not CD68-positive epithelioid histiocytes.
Kaposi sarcoma forms spindle cells with slit-like vascular spaces and extravasated red cells, and is HHV8 LANA-1 positive.

3705.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度很高，正常造血幾乎被一片片瀰漫的未成熟細胞取代，細胞核呈卵圓到梭形、排列成束狀，只在下方邊緣殘留少量紅血球系與出血區，左上角可見骨小樑；在移植後的病人身上，這符合急性骨髓性白血病復發浸潤。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow with diffuse effacement by sheets of immature mononuclear cells
Cells with ovoid to elongated/spindled nuclei in a vaguely fascicular, streaming arrangement
Fine chromatin and scant eosinophilic cytoplasm; individual nucleoli not resolved at this magnification
Few residual megakaryocytes and small foci of residual erythroid precursors and hemorrhage at the lower edge
Bony trabecula at upper left; fat spaces essentially absent
3705.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low-to-intermediate power shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with loss of fat spaces, adjacent to a bony trabecula. The marrow is diffusely replaced by sheets of immature cells with ovoid to spindled nuclei, fine chromatin, and scant cytoplasm arranged in a streaming, vaguely fascicular pattern. Residual normal hematopoiesis is limited to scattered megakaryocytes and small erythroid foci at the periphery. In the clinical context of prior AML and stem cell transplant, findings are suggestive of relapsed acute myeloid leukemia; spindled morphology warrants immunohistochemistry (CD34, CD117, MPO, lysozyme) and chimerism studies to confirm myeloid lineage and exclude a non-hematopoietic neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Metastatic sarcoma or spindle cell carcinoma
ddx.vs: Spindled marrow infiltrates can mimic sarcoma, but relapsed AML is positive for CD34/CD117/MPO or lysozyme and negative for keratins and lineage-specific mesenchymal markers.
PTLD cells are usually round lymphoid cells or plasmacytoid/immunoblastic cells expressing CD20 or CD79a and often EBER, rather than myeloid markers.
Regenerating marrow shows trilineage maturation with erythroid islands and maturing granulocytes, not uniform sheets of immature cells.
Spindled mast cell aggregates are paratrabecular/perivascular with fibrosis and eosinophils and are CD117/tryptase/CD25 positive but CD34 and MPO negative.

3449.recognize_zh: 多顆紅血球內均勻散布著許多深藍紫色、粗大的點狀顆粒（coarse basophilic stippling），分布於整個細胞；背景另有標靶細胞。粗大嗜鹼性點彩可見於鉛中毒、地中海型貧血與嘧啶 5'-核苷酸酶缺乏。
features: Several red cells with numerous coarse, evenly distributed blue-purple punctate inclusions (coarse basophilic stippling)
Stippled cells are normal-sized to slightly larger with slightly bluish tint
Occasional target cells and cells with enlarged central pallor
Few red cells with a single small dark dot (Howell-Jolly body-like) and some with refractile ring artifacts
No nucleated red cells or parasites identified
3449.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells with mild anisocytosis, occasional target cells and several erythrocytes containing numerous coarse, evenly dispersed blue-purple granules throughout the cytoplasm, representing coarse basophilic stippling. A few red cells contain single small dark dots, and some show refractile drying artifact. No parasites or nucleated red cells are present. Findings are consistent with coarse basophilic stippling, which should prompt evaluation for lead poisoning, thalassemia, pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase deficiency or dyserythropoiesis.

ddx.vs: Pappenheimer bodies are few, small clustered granules at the cell periphery that stain with Prussian blue, whereas stippling is numerous granules spread evenly over the whole cell.
Howell-Jolly bodies are single, larger, round dense nuclear remnants rather than many fine to coarse dots.
Parasites show ring forms with a chromatin dot and cytoplasm, and Schüffner dots occur in enlarged infected cells with visible parasites.
Platelets and precipitate lie on top of cells in a different focal plane and are not uniformly distributed within the red cell.

3321.recognize_zh: 血片中數顆中型淋巴細胞，核圓形居中、染色質中度濃縮，細胞質淡藍中量並有不規則小突起，符合毛細胞白血病變異型的腫瘤細胞；背景紅血球變形明顯（棘狀、碎片、橢圓形）。
features: Intermediate-sized lymphoid cells with round, centrally placed nuclei
Moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli not clearly resolved at this magnification
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm with irregular, short cytoplasmic projections
Background marked poikilocytosis with echinocytes, elliptocytes and fragmented red cells
Occasional small mature lymphocytes and a granulocyte for comparison; platelets appear reduced
3321.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked red cell poikilocytosis including echinocytes, elliptocytes and fragments, with apparently reduced platelets. Several intermediate-sized atypical lymphoid cells are present, with round central nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin and moderate pale blue cytoplasm bearing irregular short projections. Nucleolar detail is limited at this magnification. Findings are consistent with circulating neoplastic cells of hairy cell leukemia variant in the appropriate immunophenotypic context (CD11c+, CD103+, CD25-, annexin A1-).

ddx.vs: Classic HCL is usually leukopenic with monocytopenia, has bean-shaped nuclei without prominent nucleoli, and is CD25/CD123/annexin A1 and BRAF V600E positive.
SMZL villous lymphocytes have polar short villi, more condensed chromatin and are CD103 negative.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL cells have broad-based villous projections without nucleoli and express cyclin D3, with overlap requiring integration of phenotype and genetics.
Prolymphocytes have a single prominent nucleolus and lack cytoplasmic projections.

3385.recognize_zh: 中性球細胞質中有一條淡藍色、邊界清楚的長條形包涵體（Döhle-like body），但沒有毒性顆粒；旁邊可見體積接近紅血球一半以上的大血小板，是 May-Hegglin（MYH9 相關疾病）的組合。
features: Segmented neutrophil with a pale blue, elongated, well-demarcated cytoplasmic inclusion
No toxic granulation or cytoplasmic vacuolization in the neutrophil
Large platelets adjacent to the neutrophil and at the top of the field
Giant platelet with granular purple center and pale periphery
Red cells largely normocytic with minimal shape variation
3385.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a segmented neutrophil containing a pale blue, elongated, sharply demarcated cytoplasmic inclusion resembling a Döhle body, without accompanying toxic granulation or vacuolization. Large platelets are present adjacent to the neutrophil and elsewhere in the field. Red cells are unremarkable. The combination of Döhle-like neutrophil inclusions and macrothrombocytes is consistent with an MYH9-related disorder (May-Hegglin anomaly).

ddx.vs: Reactive Döhle bodies are smaller, paler peripheral patches accompanied by toxic granulation and vacuoles with normal-sized platelets.
Bernard-Soulier has giant platelets but no neutrophil inclusions, and shows absent ristocetin aggregation with GPIb-IX deficiency.
ITP may have mildly enlarged platelets but lacks neutrophil inclusions; MYH9 immunofluorescence shows abnormal myosin clumps only in MYH9 disorders.
Gray platelet syndrome shows large pale agranular gray platelets without neutrophil cytoplasmic inclusions.

3257.recognize_zh: 骨小樑表面的淺凹陷（Howship lacuna）中貼著一顆多核巨細胞，約五個大小一致、分開的圓形核，細胞質嗜酸性，即蝕骨細胞（osteoclast）；可與單一分葉核的巨核細胞區分。
features: Multinucleated giant cell with about five uniform, separate, round-to-oval nuclei
Moderate eosinophilic, slightly granular cytoplasm
Cell sits in a shallow resorption bay (Howship lacuna) on the surface of a bony trabecula
Adjacent lamellar bone with an osteocyte in its lacuna
Marrow space with scattered hematopoietic cells and hyperchromatic lobulated cells (likely megakaryocytes)
3257.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy section shows a bony trabecula with a multinucleated giant cell applied to its surface within a shallow resorption bay. The cell contains multiple separate, uniform round nuclei and moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm, features of an osteoclast. The adjacent marrow space contains scattered hematopoietic cells, including hyperchromatic lobulated forms likely representing megakaryocytes. Findings represent a normal osteoclast engaged in bone resorption; increased numbers would suggest high bone turnover such as hyperparathyroidism or metastatic disease.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have a single large multilobated nucleus and sit within the marrow space adjacent to sinusoids rather than on bone surfaces with multiple discrete nuclei.
Osteoblasts are mononuclear cells with an eccentric nucleus, basophilic cytoplasm and paranuclear hof that line bone in rows during bone formation.
Granulomatous giant cells lie within epithelioid histiocyte aggregates away from bone surfaces and are not seated in resorption lacunae.
Tumor giant cells show nuclear pleomorphism, hyperchromasia and atypical mitoses, unlike the uniform bland nuclei of an osteoclast.

3129.recognize_zh: 數顆中型淋巴球，核輪廓不規則、有凹陷或腎形切跡，染色質中度凝集，胞質少且嗜鹼，邊緣有小突起（cytoplasmic blebs），符合T細胞前淋巴球白血病（T-PLL）。
features: Intermediate-sized lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio
Irregular nuclear contours with notches, indentations, and reniform shapes
Moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli not conspicuous in this field
Scant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with irregular borders and small cytoplasmic blebs
Monomorphic population with no smudge cells
3129.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a monomorphic population of intermediate-sized lymphoid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios. Nuclei are irregular with notches and reniform indentations, and chromatin is moderately condensed without conspicuous nucleoli in this field (consistent with the small-cell variant). The scant cytoplasm is deeply basophilic with irregular borders and small blebs.
