Findings are consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD2, CD3, CD5, CD7 bright) and TCL1A/MTCP1 rearrangement is recommended.

ddx.vs: Sézary cells show finely folded cerebriform nuclei and typically lose CD7 and CD26, whereas T-PLL retains strong CD7.
ATLL cells show deeply polylobated flower-like nuclei, express CD25, and are HTLV-1 associated.
B-PLL cells are larger with a single prominent central nucleolus and more abundant cytoplasm, and are B-lineage by flow cytometry.
T-LGL cells have abundant pale cytoplasm with azurophilic granules and round nuclei.

2873.recognize_zh: 一顆巨大細胞，淡藍色細胞質中可見多個彼此分離、形狀不規則的核葉，為核過度分葉、分離的巨核細胞（megakaryocyte），可見於巨母紅血球性貧血。
features: Very large megakaryocyte with abundant pale blue, finely granular cytoplasm
Numerous irregular nuclear lobes that appear separated rather than compactly joined
Nuclear lobes with open, finely dispersed chromatin
Surrounding small dark erythroblasts and red cells for scale
2873.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large megakaryocyte with abundant pale blue, finely granular cytoplasm and numerous irregular nuclear lobes that appear separated from one another, with relatively open chromatin. Small erythroid precursors and red cells surround the cell. Hyperlobated megakaryocytes with separated lobes can be seen in megaloblastic anemia, consistent with the clinical context of pyrimethamine exposure, although this finding alone is not specific.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts have multiple discrete round, uniform nuclei with single nucleoli and coarsely granular cytoplasm, rather than irregular interconnected megakaryocytic lobes.
MDS favors micromegakaryocytes and small hypolobated or widely separated round nuclei, with dysplasia in other lineages and clonal abnormalities.
Reactive megakaryocytes show compact, joined lobulation without the open chromatin of megaloblastic change.

2809.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片以一致的中小型母細胞為主：高核質比、核圓、染色質細緻、細胞質少且無顆粒，正常造血細胞明顯減少，符合前驅 B 淋巴母細胞白血病（B-ALL）；確診仍需流式細胞儀。
features: Monotonous population of small to intermediate blasts, roughly 1.5-2 times a red cell diameter
High N:C ratio with scant, agranular pale-blue cytoplasm
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine, homogeneous chromatin and indistinct nucleoli
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules identified
Blasts arranged in clusters and singly; residual maturing myeloid and erythroid cells markedly reduced
Some smudged/crushed cells in thicker areas of the smear
2809.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen largely replaced by a monotonous population of small to intermediate-sized blasts. The blasts have a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, round to slightly irregular nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm. Auer rods are not identified, and normal trilineage hematopoiesis is markedly reduced. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia; flow cytometric immunophenotyping (CD19, CD10, CD22, TdT, cytoplasmic CD79a) and cytogenetic studies are needed to confirm B-lineage and risk stratify.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML-M0 blasts may look identical and lack granules; separation requires flow cytometry showing myeloid markers (CD13, CD33, CD117) without B-lineage antigens.
T-ALL is morphologically indistinguishable and is separated by cytoplasmic CD3 expression and lack of CD19/CD79a.
Hematogones show a spectrum of maturation with more condensed chromatin and a normal maturational flow pattern, rather than a monotonous sheet replacing the marrow.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent lipid vacuoles and are surface-immunoglobulin positive, TdT negative.

2745.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中數顆小至中型淋巴細胞，核質比高、染色質凝集，細胞質極少，細胞邊緣可見小的細胞質突起（blebs）；小細胞外觀但帶有細胞質突起，是 T-PLL 小細胞變異型常見的線索。
features: Small to intermediate lymphoid cells with very high N:C ratio
Scant basophilic cytoplasm with small surface blebs/protrusions
Round to slightly irregular nuclei, one with a faint nuclear cleft
Moderately to markedly condensed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Normal-appearing red cells in background
2745.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several small to intermediate lymphoid cells with very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, round to slightly irregular nuclei with condensed chromatin, and scant basophilic cytoplasm bearing small surface blebs. Nucleoli are not conspicuous, as is typical of the small-cell variant. Red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia (small-cell variant) in the appropriate clinical context; immunophenotyping and TCL1A rearrangement studies are necessary for diagnosis.

ddx.vs: CLL cells have coarse block-like chromatin without cytoplasmic blebs and are CD5+/CD23+ B cells.
Small Sezary cells have cerebriform nuclear grooves and are CD7/CD26-negative, unlike TCL1-positive T-PLL cells.
T-LGL cells have abundant pale cytoplasm with azurophilic granules rather than scant blebbed basophilic cytoplasm.

2681.recognize_zh: 淋巴球核幾乎占滿細胞，箭頭所指的核與細胞膜之間有一段細長、透明無色的棒狀空隙，就是細胞質內的結晶包涵體；核染色質有條紋狀淡區。
features: Lymphocyte with very high N:C ratio and nucleus filling most of the cell
Coarse chromatin with pale linear streaks
Very thin rim of pale cytoplasm
Elongated colorless rod-shaped inclusion between nucleus and cell membrane (arrow)
Adjacent teardrop and oval red cells; blurry enlarged image
2681.describe_en: High-power, digitally enlarged view of a peripheral blood smear shows a lymphocyte with a very high N:C ratio, coarse chromatin with pale streaks, and a thin rim of cytoplasm. A narrow, unstained, rod-shaped inclusion is present at the cytoplasmic edge adjacent to the nucleus (arrow). Nearby red cells include teardrop and oval forms. Findings are consistent with a crystalline inclusion in a neoplastic lymphocyte, although the blurred enlargement makes it difficult to exclude a retraction artifact on this single cell; identifying similar inclusions in other lymphoid cells supports the interpretation.

ddx.vs: Artifactual clefts have irregular outlines and vary across the smear, whereas crystals are sharply straight-edged and reproducible in multiple neoplastic cells.
Auer rods are stained pink-purple and are found in blasts, not as clear clefts in mature lymphocytes.
Hairy cells have abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with circumferential hairy projections and oval or bean-shaped nuclei rather than scant cytoplasm with a crystal.

2105.recognize_zh: 油鏡下嗜中性球胞質含較明顯的紫紅色顆粒，細胞右下緣可見一小塊淡藍色、無顆粒的胞質斑（Döhle body），核呈 C 形帶狀至分葉，是毒性變化中 Döhle body 的典型位置與外觀。
features: Neutrophil with band to early-segmented, C-shaped nucleus and clumped chromatin
Small pale blue agranular patch at the lower-right cytoplasmic periphery (Döhle body)
Increased purple-red cytoplasmic granulation (mild toxic granulation)
Background red cells with a few stomatocyte-like central pallor forms and refractile drying artifact
Normal-sized platelets in background
2105.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at oil immersion shows a band to early-segmented neutrophil with increased purple-red cytoplasmic granulation and a small pale blue agranular patch at the lower-right cytoplasmic edge, consistent with a Döhle body. Red cells show some refractile drying artifact. Findings are consistent with reactive toxic changes in neutrophils, as seen in infection, inflammation, pregnancy, or cytokine therapy.

ddx.vs: MYH9 inclusions occur in nearly all neutrophils, are often larger and more elongated, and are accompanied by macrothrombocytopenia.
A platelet sitting on the cell is granular purple with a defined border, whereas a Döhle body is pale blue, homogeneous, and within the cytoplasm.
Stain artifact produces diffuse bluish cytoplasm across many cells rather than a discrete peripheral patch.

2041.recognize_zh: 中間一排大型細胞細胞質塞滿紫色顆粒，核被遮住，數顆可見雙葉核、中間有摺痕（butterfly nucleus），並伸出淡藍色尾狀細胞質；與右下角顆粒稀少、核較清楚的正常單核／骨髓球系細胞對比明顯。
features: Row of large cells with densely granulated cytoplasm obscuring nuclear detail
Bilobed nuclei with a central crease (butterfly/sliding-plate appearance) in several cells
Tapered, teardrop-like cell shape with pale basophilic cytoplasmic tail in some cells
Adjacent normal-appearing mononuclear cell (lower right) with indented nucleus and pale cytoplasm for comparison
Auer rod bundles not clearly seen in this field
Background red cells with drying artifact
2041.describe_en: Smear shows several large abnormal cells arranged in a row. Their cytoplasm is packed with coarse azurophilic granules that obscure the nucleus, and several have bilobed nuclei with a central fold and a pale basophilic cytoplasmic tail. A normal-appearing mononuclear cell with an indented nucleus and sparsely granular cytoplasm is present for comparison. Auer rod bundles are not definitively seen. Findings are consistent with hypergranular acute promyelocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Normal promyelocytes show a visible round nucleus, perinuclear hof and less dense granules, and are part of a maturing spectrum rather than a monotonous granule-obscured population.
The microgranular variant has similar bilobed nuclei but sparse fine granules on light microscopy, unlike the heavy coarse granulation here.
Monocytic cells have gray-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and vacuoles and are nonspecific esterase positive, whereas APL cells are intensely MPO positive and CD34/HLA-DR negative.

1977.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中許多中大型未成熟細胞，核質比高、染色質細緻，部分核有凹陷或折疊，部分細胞可見少量嗜天青顆粒；同時可見帶顆粒胞質的較成熟骨髓系細胞，代表芽細胞增加但仍有向顆粒球分化，符合 AML with maturation。
features: Numerous medium to large immature cells with high N:C ratio and finely granular chromatin
Nuclei frequently indented, folded, or irregular; nucleoli indistinct in this smear
Some cells with scant basophilic cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic/pink granules
Maturing myeloid cells present, including a cell with a bilobed nucleus and pale granular cytoplasm and a larger cell with blue-grey granular cytoplasm
Many cells partially disrupted with granular debris in the background (smearing artifact)
1977.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous medium to large immature myeloid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, finely dispersed chromatin, and frequently indented or folded nuclei; some contain fine azurophilic granules. Maturing granulocytic forms are also present, including cells with bilobed nuclei and granular cytoplasm. Many cells are disrupted, and the background contains granular debris, which limits assessment of nucleoli and Auer rods. Findings are suggestive of acute myeloid leukemia with maturation, which requires a blast count of at least 20% with at least 10% maturing granulocytic cells.

ddx.vs: AML without maturation has blasts constituting at least 90% of non-erythroid cells with less than 10% maturing granulocytes.
APL cells have bilobed, sliding-plate nuclei with dense granules or Auer rod bundles and show PML::RARA; it must be excluded urgently.
MDS with increased blasts has fewer than 20% blasts with prominent multilineage dysplasia.
AMML shows at least 20% monocytic cells with folded nuclei and nonspecific esterase positivity, whereas AML with maturation has fewer than 20% monocytes.

1849.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中混合了芽細胞/前單核球（箭頭所指的大細胞，核折疊、染色質細緻）與大量顆粒球及單核球系細胞，下方中央還有一顆含粗大紫色顆粒的異常嗜酸性球，這種骨髓單核球系增生合併異常嗜酸性球的組合提示 AML 伴 inv(16)。
features: Arrowed large cell with folded/indented nucleus, fine chromatin and moderate grey-blue cytoplasm (blast/promonocyte)
Abnormal eosinophil precursor (lower center) with coarse, dark purple basophilic-staining granules admixed with orange granules
Mixed myelomonocytic population: blasts, monocytoid cells with folded nuclei, and maturing neutrophils
Numerous segmented and band neutrophils indicating some granulocytic maturation
Hypercellular aspirate background with scattered erythrocytes
1849.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with a mixed myelomonocytic population. Large blasts and promonocytes with folded nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate grey-blue cytoplasm (arrow) are admixed with monocytoid cells and maturing neutrophils. An eosinophil precursor with abnormally large, dark purple (basophilic-staining) granules is present. Findings are consistent with acute myelomonocytic leukemia with abnormal eosinophils, as seen in AML with inv(16)(p13.1q22)/CBFB::MYH11; confirmation requires cytogenetic or molecular testing.

ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps, but lacks the abnormal eosinophils with basophilic granules and is negative for inv(16)/t(16;16) by karyotype, FISH or RT-PCR.
Shows blasts with long slender Auer rods, perinuclear hofs and salmon-colored granules rather than a monocytic component with abnormal eosinophils.
Blasts plus promonocytes are below 20% and there is persistent peripheral monocytosis, whereas inv(16) defines AML regardless of blast count.
Eosinophils have normal orange granules and blasts/promonocytes are not increased.

1785.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片可見多染性大紅血球、有核紅血球（上方深染小核與左下方嗜鹼性母紅血球），左上箭頭所指的大紅血球內有Howell-Jolly小體，右側箭頭為淡灰藍、輪廓不規則的多染性紅血球，符合新生兒溶血時的紅血球生成反應。
features: Large polychromatophilic red cells, including one containing a Howell-Jolly body (thin arrow)
Pale blue-gray, irregularly outlined polychromatophilic red cell (thick arrow)
Nucleated red cells: a small orthochromatic normoblast and an early normoblast with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and fine chromatin (lower left)
Other large immature-appearing mononuclear cells with coarse chromatin, likely erythroid precursors or lymphocytes
Macrocytic red cell background with anisocytosis; no spherocytes clearly evident at this field
1785.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows anisocytosis with numerous large polychromatophilic red cells, one containing a Howell-Jolly body (thin arrow), and a pale, irregular polychromatophilic cell (thick arrow). Nucleated red cells are present, including an orthochromatic normoblast and an early normoblast with deeply basophilic cytoplasm. Spherocytes are not prominent in this field. Findings are consistent with a brisk erythropoietic response with circulating erythroid precursors, as seen in hemolytic disease of the fetus and newborn.

ddx.vs: Healthy newborns have macrocytosis and a few nucleated red cells, but not the degree of normoblastemia and polychromasia seen in hemolytic disease, which is confirmed by a positive DAT.
Hyposplenism shows Howell-Jolly bodies with target cells and acanthocytes but without marked polychromasia or early normoblasts.

ddx.dx: Congenital dyserythropoietic anemia or megaloblastic anemia
ddx.vs: These show dysplastic or megaloblastic erythroid precursors with inappropriately low reticulocyte response rather than brisk polychromasia.

1721.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中一顆細胞含兩個分開、大小相近的細胞核，染色質粗糙團塊狀，細胞質中等量、呈深藍色且邊緣較深染，屬於雙核的反應性淋巴球樣細胞；型態上無法直接判定是否為非整倍體（aneuploid），標題需配合細胞遺傳學解讀。
features: Single binucleate cell larger than surrounding red cells
Two separate, similarly sized round nuclei with coarsely clumped chromatin; no distinct nucleoli
Moderate amount of deeply basophilic cytoplasm, darker at the periphery, with a pale perinuclear zone
Smooth oval cell outline; no granules or vacuoles
Normocytic red cells with occasional irregular forms in the background
1721.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a binucleate cell with two separate, similarly sized nuclei containing coarsely clumped chromatin and a moderate rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm with peripheral accentuation. No nucleoli, granules, or vacuoles are seen. The appearance resembles a binucleate reactive (plasmacytoid) lymphocyte, a cell that may result from abnormal mitosis or failed cytokinesis. Ploidy cannot be determined from morphology; the designation 'aneuploid cell' requires cytogenetic or DNA content correlation, so the image only partially supports the title.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with clock-face chromatin and a distinct paranuclear hof in more abundant cytoplasm.
A telophase cell shows a cleavage furrow with condensed chromosomes pulling toward opposite poles rather than two fully reconstituted interphase nuclei.
Overlapping cells show two separate cytoplasmic outlines, whereas this cell has a single continuous cell membrane.
Reed-Sternberg cells are much larger with vesicular chromatin and huge eosinophilic macronucleoli and are not found in peripheral blood.

1593.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中央一顆約為紅血球兩倍大的細胞，核分成3至4葉並以細絲相連，染色質粗塊狀，細胞質淡粉紅並有細小紫紅顆粒，是典型的分葉核中性球（segmented neutrophil）。
features: Cell about twice the diameter of a red cell
Nucleus segmented into 3-4 lobes connected by thin chromatin strands
Coarsely clumped dark chromatin without nucleoli
Pale pink cytoplasm with fine lilac (secondary) granules
Background red cells with central pallor, some overlapping, and scattered platelets
1593.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature neutrophil with a nucleus divided into three to four lobes joined by thin filaments, coarsely clumped chromatin and pale cytoplasm containing fine lilac granules. There is no toxic granulation, Döhle body, vacuolization or hypersegmentation. Background red cells show normal central pallor with some overlap, and platelets are present. Findings are consistent with a normal segmented neutrophil.

ddx.vs: A band has a curved nucleus of uniform width without filamentous constrictions, whereas this nucleus is separated into distinct lobes by thin strands.
Hypersegmentation requires six or more lobes (or >5% with five lobes), whereas this cell has three to four lobes.
Eosinophils are usually bilobed with coarse refractile orange-red granules, unlike the fine lilac granules here.

1465.recognize_zh: 這是間期 FISH 的示意圖（非型態圖）：藍色 DAPI 染色的細胞核內出現三個洋紅色探針訊號，代表該染色體區域多一份拷貝；在 CLL 的標準 FISH 組合中，這種模式即為 12 號染色體三體（trisomy 12）。
features: Schematic interphase FISH illustration rather than a photographed cell
Single round nucleus counterstained blue (DAPI)
Three discrete magenta signals from one probe within the nucleus
Three copies of a single-locus or centromeric probe indicate a trisomy (normal = two signals)
No second-color control probe is shown
1465.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic schematic of interphase fluorescence in situ hybridization. A single DAPI-counterstained nucleus contains three magenta signals from one probe, whereas a normal diploid nucleus would show two. In the chronic lymphocytic leukemia FISH panel (13q14, 11q22/ATM, 17p13/TP53, centromere 12), three signals with the chromosome 12 centromeric probe indicate trisomy 12, which carries intermediate prognosis and is associated with atypical morphology and CD38 expression. Interpretation requires scoring many nuclei against a laboratory cutoff.

60281.recognize_zh: 許多紅血球縮小、染色深且缺乏中央淡染區，血紅素不均勻地集中在細胞一側，另一側呈透明空泡狀（hemighost / blister cells），並有不規則收縮細胞（irregularly contracted cells），符合 G6PD 缺乏的氧化性溶血。
features: Numerous small, dense, irregularly contracted red cells lacking central pallor
Hemighost/blister cells with hemoglobin retracted to one side and a clear, empty membrane remnant on the other
Occasional ghost-like pale cells and spherocytic forms
Many crenated (echinocytic) red cells
Platelets numerous; a lymphocyte and a neutrophil at the field edges
60281.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked poikilocytosis with many irregularly contracted red cells that are small, dense and lack central pallor, with hemoglobin condensed unevenly within the cell. Numerous hemighost (blister) cells show hemoglobin retracted to one side, leaving a clear membrane-bound space, and occasional pale ghost cells and spherocytic forms are present. Crenated cells are also common. Findings are consistent with acute oxidative hemolysis, as in G6PD deficiency after an oxidant exposure; a G6PD assay may be falsely normal during acute hemolysis, and a Heinz body preparation can help.

ddx.vs: Spherocytes are uniformly round with smooth contour, whereas irregularly contracted cells have uneven, eccentric hemoglobin and coexist with hemighosts; DAT separates immune hemolysis.
Unstable hemoglobins also cause Heinz bodies and bite cells but are chronic with a normal G6PD assay and abnormal isopropanol stability or globin sequencing.
Artifactual echinocytes retain even hemoglobin distribution and lack the eccentric clear blister spaces seen here.
MAHA shows fragments with straight edges and thrombocytopenia, whereas this smear shows intact contracted cells and hemighosts with abundant platelets.

121.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片可見多個大顆粒淋巴球（LGL：核圓或腎形、染色質成熟、淡藍色豐富細胞質內有細小嗜天青顆粒），流式細胞儀顯示一群 CD3 陰性、CD2+/CD7+、CD5 陰性、CD4/CD8 陰性、CD56 弱陽性且 CD57 強陽性的 NK 細胞約佔淋巴球 40%，支持 NK 細胞慢性淋巴增生性疾患（CLPD-NK）。
features: Large granular lymphocytes: medium-sized cells with round to reniform mature nuclei and abundant pale blue cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules
Low N:C ratio with condensed chromatin and no visible nucleoli (no blastic or atypical features)
Background red cells include macro-ovalocytes and occasional poikilocytes; one hypersegmented-appearing neutrophil, in keeping with the macrocytic anemia
Flow: lymphocytes 42.9% of events; CD3+ T cells only 22.6% of living cells, with a large CD3-negative, CD2+, CD7+ population (CD7+CD3- 40.6% of lymphocytes)
The CD3-negative population is CD5-negative, CD4-negative, CD8 negative to dim, CD56 dim and CD57 bright (CD57+CD56+ 41.2%)
Residual CD3+ T cells show normal CD5, CD7, CD2 and mixed CD4/CD8 expression, with a CD57+ subset
121.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a relative lymphocytosis composed predominantly of large granular lymphocytes with round to indented mature nuclei and abundant pale cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules; blasts and atypical large lymphoid cells are not seen. Red cells show macro-ovalocytes with mild poikilocytosis, and a hypersegmented-appearing neutrophil is present. Flow cytometry identifies an expanded population (~40% of lymphocytes) of surface CD3-negative lymphocytes that express CD2, CD7, dim CD56 and bright CD57 and lack CD5 and CD4, with CD8 negative to dim; the residual T cells have a normal immunophenotype. Findings are consistent with a chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells in the appropriate clinical setting of persistent NK lymphocytosis; evidence of clonality or restriction (e.g., KIR/CD158 isoform restriction, CD94/NKG2A, STAT3 mutation) and exclusion of reactive causes are recommended.

ddx.vs: T-LGL cells are morphologically identical but are surface CD3+ (usually CD8+, CD57+) with clonal TCR rearrangement, whereas the LGLs here are surface CD3-negative NK cells.

Aggressive NK-cell leukemia shows atypical, often larger cells with nucleoli, is EBV-positive, typically CD56 bright and CD57 negative, and presents with fulminant systemic illness, unlike this indolent CD57-bright population in an elderly patient.

Reactive expansions (viral infection, post-splenectomy, autoimmune disease) are transient and show polyclonal KIR expression, so persistence >6 months and KIR restriction or STAT3 mutation are needed to separate it from CLPD-NK.

Hairy cells have circumferential hair-like projections without azurophilic granules and are CD19/CD20+, CD11c+, CD25+, CD103+ B cells, whereas these granular cells are CD2+/CD7+ NK cells lacking B-cell markers.

captions: PB smear: large granular lymphocyte with reniform nucleus and azurophilic granules; macro-ovalocytes in background
PB smear: hypersegmented-appearing neutrophil among macro-ovalocytes
PB smear: two large granular lymphocytes with abundant pale cytoplasm and fine azurophilic granules
Flow, CD45 vs SSC: lymphocyte gate 42.88%, monocytes 1.00%, blasts 0.13%
Flow, CD3 vs SSC: CD3+ T cells only 22.63% of living cells, with a large CD3-negative lymphoid population
Flow, CD3 vs CD5: CD3-negative population (green) lacks CD5; T cells (blue) CD3+CD5+
Flow, CD3 vs CD7: CD7+CD3- lymphocytes 40.63%
Flow, CD7 vs CD2: NK population (green) co-expresses CD2 and CD7; B cells (magenta) negative
Flow, CD5 vs CD7: NK cells CD7+ CD5-negative; T cells CD5+
Flow, CD3 vs CD2: CD2+ CD3-negative NK population
Flow, CD8 vs CD4: NK population negative for CD4 and CD8 (at most dim CD8); T cells show CD4 and CD8 subsets
Flow, CD56 vs CD57: CD57+CD56+ population 41.22% with dim CD56
Flow, CD3 vs CD57: bright CD57 on CD3-negative NK cells, plus a CD57+ T-cell subset

57.recognize_zh: 淋巴結結構消失，由小到中型、胞質透明的淋巴球與豐富分支小血管混合浸潤；免疫染色顯示 CD21/CD23 類濾泡樹突細胞網向濾泡外擴張，腫瘤性 T 細胞表現 CD10、PD-1、CXCL13（TFH 表型），流式可見 CD5+CD10+ T 細胞群，符合血管免疫母細胞性 T 細胞淋巴瘤（AITL）。
features: Effaced lymph node architecture with infiltrate extending into perinodal fat
Polymorphous infiltrate of small-to-medium lymphocytes with abundant clear cytoplasm and mildly irregular nuclei
Prominent arborizing high endothelial venules; admixed histiocytes, plasma cells and scattered large immunoblasts
Irregular, expanded extrafollicular follicular dendritic cell meshworks around vessels
Neoplastic T cells CD3+/CD4+/CD5+ with CD10, PD-1 and CXCL13 (TFH) expression; CD8+ cells are small reactive cells
Scattered EBER-positive cells and large CD20+ B blasts in the background
57.describe_en: Sections of lymph node show effacement of the normal architecture by a diffuse polymorphous infiltrate that extends into perinodal adipose tissue, with residual B-cell areas compressed toward the periphery. At higher power the infiltrate consists of small-to-medium lymphocytes with abundant clear cytoplasm, admixed with prominent arborizing high endothelial venules, histiocytes, other inflammatory cells and scattered large immunoblasts, including occasional mitoses. Immunohistochemistry shows sheets of CD3+, CD4+, CD5+ T cells co-expressing CD10, PD-1 and CXCL13, with scattered CD20+ large B cells, CD8+ small reactive T cells, irregular expanded follicular dendritic cell meshworks outside follicles, scattered large cells highlighted by an unlabeled membranous/Golgi stain (likely CD30), and scattered EBER-positive cells by in situ hybridization. Flow cytometry identifies a CD5+ CD10+ CD19- T-cell population. Findings are consistent with angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma (nodal T-follicular helper cell lymphoma, angioimmunoblastic type).

ddx.vs: Scattered CD30+/PAX5+ large cells can mimic Hodgkin cells, but AITL shows an abnormal CD10+/PD-1+ TFH T-cell population with expanded FDC meshworks and T-cell clonality, which cHL lacks.
PTCL-NOS lacks expression of at least two TFH markers (CD10, PD-1, CXCL13, BCL6, ICOS) and does not show the extrafollicular FDC expansion and arborizing HEVs typical of AITL.

ddx.dx: Reactive paracortical hyperplasia / drug or viral lymphadenopathy
ddx.vs: Reactive nodes preserve sinuses and follicles, lack clear-cell TFH cells outside follicles, and show no CD10+ T-cell population by flow or monoclonal TCR rearrangement.

Here the large B cells are scattered EBV-associated bystanders while the neoplastic population is a CD10+/PD-1+ T-cell population, whereas THRLBCL has monoclonal large B cells in a background of non-TFH reactive T cells and histiocytes.

57.stain: H&E; IHC panel (CD3, CD10, PD-1, CXCL13); ISH: EBER; flow
captions: H&E, medium power: diffuse polymorphous infiltrate of clear-cytoplasm lymphocytes with numerous small vessels
H&E, low power: effaced node with infiltrate extending into perinodal fat
H&E, high power: clear-cell atypical lymphocytes, high endothelial venules, immunoblasts and a mitotic figure
CD20 (low and high power) and CD3: peripherally compressed B-cell areas with scattered large B cells; CD3+ atypical T cells
Unlabeled FDC marker (e.g. CD21/CD23): irregular expanded extrafollicular dendritic cell meshworks around vessels
CD4, CD5 and CD8: atypical T cells CD4+/CD5+; CD8 marks small reactive T cells
CD10, PD-1 and CXCL13: TFH marker expression by neoplastic T cells
Flow cytometry: CD5+ CD10+ CD19- T-cell population (open arrow) and a small CD19+ B-cell population (arrow)
Unlabeled IHC (likely CD30): scattered large cells with membranous and Golgi-type staining
EBER in situ hybridization: scattered EBV-positive cells

3577.recognize_zh: 一顆大型、胞質灰藍且缺乏顆粒的細胞內含十多個大小不一的圓形深紫色核碎片（核碎裂 karyorrhexis 樣），旁有數顆未成熟髓系細胞；依標題解讀為顆粒球發育不良的核碎裂，但也需排除凋亡細胞或吞噬碎片的巨噬細胞。
features: Large cell with gray-blue, largely agranular cytoplasm
Numerous round, dense, dark purple nuclear fragments of varying size scattered in the cytoplasm (karyorrhexis-like)
Adjacent immature myeloid cells with fine chromatin and pale gray cytoplasm
Red cells show crenation and refractile 'water artifact' holes from slow drying
Small platelet clump at lower left
3577.describe_en: Smear (likely bone marrow aspirate) shows a large cell with gray-blue, essentially agranular cytoplasm containing numerous round, dense nuclear fragments of variable size, accompanied by several immature myeloid cells. Red cells show drying artifact with refractile holes and crenation. In the context of dysgranulopoiesis, the cell is interpreted as a dysplastic granulocytic precursor with nuclear fragmentation and hypogranularity. However, a single fragmented cell is not specific, and an apoptotic cell or a macrophage containing ingested nuclear debris cannot be excluded without evaluating additional fields.

ddx.vs: Apoptotic neutrophils are normal-sized with shrunken pink granular cytoplasm and a few dense round nuclear fragments, rather than a large agranular cell.

ddx.dx: Macrophage with ingested apoptotic bodies (tingible-body macrophage)
ddx.vs: A macrophage retains its own separate reniform nucleus and shows vacuolated cytoplasm around ingested debris.
Dyserythropoietic cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm and nuclear buds or internuclear bridging, and they lack granulocytic features.

61625.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片可見明顯紅血球大小不等與異形（anisopoikilocytosis）：混有正常色與淡染的紅血球、靶形細胞、橢圓形與淚滴狀紅血球及棘狀細胞；環形鐵粒母細胞只能在骨髓鐵染色看到，本圖僅提供支持性的紅血球異常線索。
features: Marked anisopoikilocytosis with target cells, elliptocytes, teardrop cells and an occasional echinocyte/acanthocyte
Suggestion of a dimorphic red cell population with some paler, hypochromic cells among normochromic cells
Leukocytes present are mature-appearing: small lymphocytes and a cell with moderate cytoplasm and coarse nucleus
Platelets adequate in this field with some variation in size
Ring sideroblasts are not assessable on peripheral blood
61625.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis, including target cells, elliptocytes, teardrop cells, and occasional echinocytes, with a suggestion of a dimorphic population in which some red cells appear paler than others. The few leukocytes in the field are mature lymphocytes without obvious blasts, and platelets appear adequate. These red cell changes are nonspecific; ring sideroblasts must be demonstrated on an iron-stained bone marrow aspirate. In the appropriate clinical context, the findings are compatible with the peripheral blood picture of myelodysplastic syndrome with ring sideroblasts.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency shows uniformly microcytic hypochromic cells and pencil cells with low ferritin and absent marrow iron, without ring sideroblasts.

ddx.dx: Congenital sideroblastic anemia or acquired non-clonal sideroblastic anemia (alcohol, copper deficiency, drugs)
ddx.vs: These also produce dimorphic red cells and ring sideroblasts, so separation requires history, copper/B6 levels, and SF3B1 mutation or cytogenetic evidence of clonality.
Thalassemia shows microcytosis with high RBC count and numerous target cells, normal iron stores, and abnormal hemoglobin studies rather than a dimorphic population.
